jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Ads Pangle - USDS
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

About the team
Pangle is the ad network of TikTok for Business, helping mobile developers accelerate growth, deliver engaging ad experiences, and maximize revenue by accessing TikTok's global advertising demand. Operating in more than 36 countries and regions, Pangle has built a strong reputation for driving measurable results for app partners worldwide.
As Pangle expands into the U.S. market, we're building our advertising platform from the ground up — tackling exciting new challenges in large-scale systems, optimization, and machine learning. Join us to shape the future of mobile monetization and grow your career in a fast-moving, global team.

Responsibilities
- Develop and optimize bidding algorithms and strategies across Pangle's ad delivery systems, including targeting, retrieval, ranking, and bidding models, with a focus on improving monetization efficiency and overall ad ROI.
- Improve the performance and efficiency of large-scale, online-learning–based deep models for real-time advertising applications.
- Apply advanced modeling techniques and strategic thinking to enhance attribution accuracy, delivery quality, and long-term ecosystem sustainability. Identify and drive innovative commercialization technologies and product solutions.
- Design, build, and iterate on core ad prediction models such as CTR (Click-Through Rate) and CVR (Conversion Rate) models.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualification(s):
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or related technical disciplines.
- 3+ years of hands-on experience with building and training complex and scalable machine learning systems.
- Strong Computer Science fundamentals (algorithms, data structures, software design) and problem-solving skills.
- Strong coding skills and a solid understanding of machine learning algorithms, particularly deep learning and ranking models.
- Experience leading or driving machine learning projects.

Preferred Qualification(s):
- Strong theoretical background in machine learning and deep learning, with proficiency in at least one major framework (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch).
- Demonstrated experience optimizing large-scale advertising systems, including bidding algorithms and delivery strategies. Familiarity with OCPC, OCPM, and AEO bidding models, and understanding of ad delivery mechanisms.
- Excellent teamwork and communication skills, with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to move projects forward independently.
- Strong business and data intuition, passion for tackling complex problems, and proven ability in abstraction, project execution, and innovation.

About USDS

TikTok USDS Joint Venture LLC is dedicated to the safety and security of millions of Americans who create, discover, and connect with what they love on the apps we operate. The Joint Venture has been established in compliance with the Executive Order signed by President Trump on September 25, 2025. Our foundation is a comprehensive data privacy and cybersecurity program we operate under defined safeguards to protect national security and secure U.S. user data, apps and the algorithm. We safeguard the U.S. content ecosystem, holding decision-making authority for trust and safety policies and moderation. USDS Joint Venture helps ensure Americans can continue to express their creativity, discover new hobbies and interests, and build thriving communities and businesses on a global scale.​
​
On-site presence across teams allows the company to operate with greater speed, alignment, and agility — especially in areas like real-time decision-making, team development, and integrated execution. As such, the company is shifting from a hybrid work model to a fully in-person schedule up to 5 days a week.​

Why Join Us

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.​
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​
​
Diversity & Inclusion​
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​

jobs.description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer on the Engine Security Behavioral Detection team, you will focus on building scalable ML systems to detect malicious behavior, automated play, and exploits using real-time or offline analysis to ensure platform safety and integrity. You will be at the forefront of protecting the Roblox community, developing sophisticated models that distinguish between legitimate player interactions and adversarial activities in a massive, dynamic 3D ecosystem. You will own the lifecycle of detection models, from identifying emerging threat patterns to deploying high-throughput inference services. Your work will bridge the gap between complex behavioral analysis and system-wide mitigation, ensuring that Roblox remains a safe and fair environment for millions of creators and players globally.

You Will

Design and implement end-to-end ML pipelines for anomaly detection and behavior analysis.
Develop and deploy models that can identify complex, adversarial bot patterns and game exploits.
Work on real-time or offline inference systems that can mitigate malicious activity without disrupting user experience.
Collaborate with security teams, data scientists, and backend engineers to harden the platform against evolving threats.

You Have

PhD or Master’s in Computer Science, Data Science, or related field.
4+ years of experience in ML engineering, specifically in behavior modeling, anomaly detection, or fraud detection.
Proficiency with time-series analysis, neural networks, or large-scale classification systems.
Experience training and deploying models on high-throughput, low-latency production systems.
Proficiency in Python (PyTorch/TensorFlow) and familiarity with big data processing frameworks (e.g., Spark, Flink, or similar).
Strong problem-solving skills and a passion for platform integrity and security.

Job Expectations

Deliver high-impact ML solutions that directly improve platform security and trust.
Take ownership of model monitoring and retuning strategies to counter adaptive adversary tactics.
Provide technical guidance on best practices for feature engineering in adversarial domains.
Maintain operational excellence, ensuring reliability and scalability of detection services.

.

jobs.title: Sr. AI Scientist, Agentic Science/Generative Models, AI for Biology & Translation (AIBT)
jobs.description:
The Position

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Advances in AI, data, and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organisations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximising these opportunities. The new Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness the transformative power of data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to assist our scientists in both pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative and transformative medicines for patients worldwide.

The Opportunity

The AI Biology & Translation (AIBT) department within Genentech's Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CS-CoE) is building the next generation of AI systems for biology. Our mission is to develop AI models that learn from biological data at unprecedented scale, generating new insights into disease mechanisms, therapeutic opportunities, and human biology. We seek a highly motivated and passionate Senior ML Engineer to join our Generative Modeling team and help build and scale foundation models and agentic systems for therapeutic discovery. The successful candidate will contribute to the design, development, and scaling of large-scale foundation models and AI agents, with the ultimate aim of accelerating target and drug discovery. This role spans the full stack: the agent design and orchestration logic that makes these systems scientifically useful, and the infrastructure, AgentOps, and MLOps that make them robust, reproducible, and efficient at scale. Depending on team coverage at a given time, you may own infrastructure end-to-end or partner with platform engineering on it, this role needs someone comfortable doing either. You'll join a multidisciplinary environment alongside ML scientists, ML engineers, and computational biologists. The ideal candidate combines strong software and ML engineering skills, a systems mindset, fluency in how agentic systems are actually built and evaluated, and a "get-it-done" attitude.

In this role, you will:

Agentic systems

Build agents that use tools, retrieve evidence, and reason across multi-step scientific workflows
Build reliable interfaces between agents and biological, genomic, and clinical data sources
Design evaluation harnesses that check agent output against scientific ground truth
Design and implement self-improving and autonomous loops for autoML and lab in the loop
Implement agent memory and context management for long-horizon workflows

Models and production systems

Build, finetune, deploy, and scale foundation models and LLMs in production
Own production Python/PyTorch (or JAX) codebases that turn fast-moving research ideas into reliable, reusable software
Own the MLOps/AgentOps lifecycle: experiment tracking, evaluation, monitoring, reproducibility, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Helm, Kubernetes)

Collaboration

Work with research scientists to turn open-ended scientific problems into scoped, shippable systems
Raise the engineering bar across gRED and Roche

Who You Are

BS/MS in CS, ML, engineering, or a related quantitative field
5+ years building and shipping ML systems in industry
Excellent Python; strong software and data engineering fundamentals (Git, automated testing, CI/CD, documentation)
Track record leading technical projects end to end
Comfort with ambiguity and close collaboration with scientists
Strong problem-solving and communication skills
Interest or experience in applying ML to scientific discovery (AI for science), such as biology, chemistry, or drug discovery, including working with domain-specific data and models.

Preferred

Inference-time scaling and optimization: test-time compute, sampling and search strategies, model routing, batching, caching, latency/cost/quality tradeoffs
ML infrastructure on AWS (EC2, S3, EKS, SageMaker), including distributed training and inference on HPC
Evaluation systems for agentic applications where correctness is scientifically defined
Agent orchestration frameworks in production (LangGraph, MCP-based tool integration)

available for this job posting

jobs.title: Senior Applied AI/ML Scientist
jobs.description:
Senior Applied AI/ML Scientist – Scientific Machine Learning & Physics AI

Industry:
Artificial Intelligence | Engineering Simulation | Scientific Computing
Location:
San Mateo, CA
Work Arrangement:
On-site preferred (5 days per week); exceptional remote candidates may be considered
Employment Type:
Full-Time
Openings:
2
Travel:
Occasional travel to customer engineering sites

Build AI Models That Understand Physics, Not Just Data

We are looking for a Senior / Principal Applied AI/ML Scientist who specializes in applying deep learning to physical systems, engineering simulations, and scientific computing.

This is not a conventional Machine Learning or Generative AI position. The focus is on developing AI models that learn from complex engineering simulation data and can predict physical behavior across different geometries, mesh structures, and engineering conditions.

We are particularly interested in professionals who have combined a background in computational physics, CFD, FEA, applied mathematics, or scientific computing with hands-on deep learning and scientific ML development.

You will develop physics-based surrogate models, work with neural operators and mesh-based architectures, and take models from research and experimentation into real engineering applications.

What You Will Work On

Design and train deep learning models that approximate computationally expensive engineering simulations.

Develop physics-based surrogate models using neural operators, Graph Neural Networks, and geometric deep learning.

Work with unstructured meshes, changing geometries, and variable point-count datasets rather than relying exclusively on fixed-grid or conventional image-based data.

Build and optimize model architectures, training pipelines, hyperparameters, and validation processes using Python and PyTorch.

Validate model predictions against ground-truth engineering simulations.

Collaborate with computational engineers to understand physical constraints, simulation data quality, and engineering requirements.

Work alongside data scientists, platform engineers, and customer engineering teams to deploy models into production engineering workflows.

Translate research developments in scientific ML into practical solutions for real engineering problems.

What Background Will Make You Successful?

We are particularly interested in candidates coming from one or more of these professional backgrounds:

Scientific Machine Learning / Physics-Informed ML Research.
Computational Physics or Applied Mathematics with deep learning experience.
CFD, FEA, or CAE engineering professionals who have transitioned into scientific ML.
Research Scientists specializing in neural operators, surrogate modeling, or geometric deep learning.
Applied AI/ML Scientists developing models for engineering simulations and physical systems.

Technical Expertise Required

Scientific Machine Learning & Model Development

Hands-on development of physics-based surrogate models.
Neural Operators and physics-informed machine learning.
Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), geometric deep learning, or mesh-based architectures.
Experience with unstructured meshes, varying geometries, and variable point counts across simulation samples.

Programming & Deep Learning

Strong Python and PyTorch experience.
Experience designing, training, tuning, and evaluating deep learning architectures.
Familiarity with JAX is beneficial.

Engineering & Simulation Knowledge

Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD).
Finite Element Analysis (FEA).
Thermal simulation and CAE workflows.
Scientific computing and numerical simulation.

Relevant Technologies

PhysicsNeMo, Transolver, MeshGraphNet, Neural Operators, Diffusion Models, GPU Computing, Distributed Training, and High-Performance Computing (HPC).

Experience & Education

Typically, 5+ years of hands-on applied ML experience involving engineering, scientific, or simulation data.
Strong experience building and deploying ML models in engineering or scientific applications.
Experience working directly with customers or internal engineering teams to deliver ML solutions.
Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline preferred.

Exceptional early-career candidates with a PhD and 1–2 years of directly relevant experience will also be considered.

Additional Information

San Mateo, CA is the preferred work location, with five days per week in the office.
Exceptional candidates unable to work on-site may be considered for remote arrangements.
Occasional travel to customer sites is expected.

Who Should Apply?

If your experience combines engineering simulation, scientific computing, and hands-on machine learning model development, we would like to hear from you.

We are particularly interested in professionals who have moved beyond conventional ML applications and have built models that learn the underlying behavior of physical systems.

Please submit your updated resume highlighting your experience with scientific ML, simulation datasets, surrogate modeling, neural operators, and engineering applications.

Our mission is to empower people to live healthier lives by leveraging our wearables, smartphones, medical devices, AI, and health services. We research, develop, and commercialize innovative digital health products and solutions by bringing together the full capabilities of our team, including product strategy and management, clinical expertise, partnerships, UI/UX design, usability research, clinical research and validation, software development, AI / Gen AI, and regulatory. Millions of Samsung users’ lives around the world have been touched by our products, including the Samsung HeartWise for cardiac rehabilitation and the Samsung ECG Monitor App. Samsung’s unique advantage in the consumer electronics market and growing focus on Digital Health and AI / Gen AI provides exciting technical challenges and rewarding career experience. Join us!

Position Summary

Samsung Research America Digital Health Team is looking for an outstanding Ph.D.-level Senior AI Research Engineer with solid ML/AI technology background and digital health-related research project experiences in digital biomarker, physiological signal processing and deep learning. You need to have a strong track-record of success in academic and/or industrial settings, with the ability to scale algorithms and models to large, real-world datasets.

You will play a key role in delivering innovation in digital health domain, creating technologies and intellectual properties, deploying and validating novel algorithms, and transferring mature outcomes to production and scientific publications in top-tier venues. We expect candidates who have solid data analytics skills and project experiences in areas such as health foundation models pre and post training, wearable computing, and algorithm development for health applications. Your work will significantly benefit real-world wearable users, seniors, physicians and care givers. Samsung's unique advantage in the consumer electronics market and growing focus on digital health will provide you with exciting technical challenges and a rewarding career experience.

Position Responsibilities

Research and develop novel AI/ML algorithms and foundation models for physiological signal processing, sensor fusion, and digital biomarkers in wearable health applications, leveraging self-supervised learning, transformer models, and computer vision models on very large-scale real-world user datasets
Design and implement deep learning and statistical models to analyze multi-modal biosignals (e.g., EEG, ECG, PPG, motion data) in real-time and batch settings
Scale algorithms to handle large, multi-terabyte datasets from wearables and biomedical sensors on cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) while maintaining algorithmic efficiency
Collaborate with hardware and software engineers to integrate AI models into wearable platforms, ensuring efficient on-device inference
Conduct feasibility studies, benchmark AI-driven features, and refine models for accuracy and scalability across diverse populations
Work with clinical and regulatory teams to ensure model robustness, validation, and compliance with healthcare standards
Stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in digital health, computational neuroscience, and edge AI to drive innovation in wearables
Generate patents and scientific research papers for top-tier publications

PhD in AI, Machine Learning, Biomedical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience
3+ years of experience in data analytics and project experiences in areas such as health foundation models pre and post training, wearable computing, and algorithm development for health applications
3+ years of experience in ML/DL frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch) and programming languages (Python, C++)
Track record of publishing in high-impact AI/ML venues (ICML, ICLR, NeurIPS, etc.) or top-tier journals (Nature, Science, etc.)
Experience with deep learning on time-series data and sequence models (LSTMs, attention mechanisms, temporal convolutions)
Experience with time-series analysis, signal processing, and sensor fusion for wearable or biomedical applications
Familiarity with biomedical sensing modalities (EEG, ECG, PPG, SpO2, etc.) and data-driven health insights
Experience designing and optimizing algorithms to work efficiently with large-scale datasets and distributed computing environments
Experience in developing PoCs and exploratory research projects in emerging sensing technologies

Special Attributes

Understanding of clinical workflows and healthcare data privacy considerations (HIPAA, FDA, MDR, etc.)
Knowledge of wearable hardware constraints, power optimization, and real-time processing
Familiarity with on-device ML optimization and model compression techniques
Experience scaling algorithms and model training on cloud compute infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure) or distributed computing environments

About this opportunity

This role is being recruited by Calyptus on behalf of one of our clients.
Calyptus is a specialist recruitment partner helping startups and high-growth technology companies hire across engineering, product and design.

What to expect

We’ll review your application and, if your experience is a strong match, one of our team will be in touch
We’ll support you throughout the interview process and keep you updated at each stage
If this particular role isn’t the right fit, we may consider you for other relevant opportunities with our clients

______________________________________________________

A new open-source model is released and you are compelled to reach inside and understand how it actually works. You instinctively try to push it beyond what most people say is already impressive. You observe model behavior and don’t think, “What’s a better prompt?”, but “How do I improve its fundamentals?”

Our Senior Machine Learning Engineer will operate deep within the model stack, working directly with weights, activations, and architectures to build the systems that make AI governance deterministic. Your work powers the Policy Engine, the core technology that gives enterprises real-time, auditable control over model behavior in production. Your mandate is ostensibly simple but difficult in execution: determine how a model can be improved for a specific purpose and build the systems that operationalize that within our platform.

As opposed to simply using models, you will probe the mechanics of their cognition.

What You Will Do

Take ideas from mechanistic interpretability and related work and turn them into code that runs in production, making research into reality.
Work directly with model internals to improve behavior and performance across commercial and open-source models.
Leverage techniques like activation patching, control vectors, and feature extraction to achieve targeted, repeatable improvements in model output.
Build the evaluation and deployment loops needed to ship changes reliably into enterprise environments.
Design and optimize the feature-level intervention systems that enable deterministic policy enforcement at inference time.

Who You Are

Strong understanding of Transformer architectures, PyTorch internals, and the mathematical foundations of deep learning.
Have trained, fine-tuned, or optimized models beyond superficial augmentation.
Can read a paper, decide what matters, and implement it.
Notice when something is not working and take ownership of fixing it.
Motivated by the challenge of making large language models reliable and controllable enough for the highest-stakes enterprise applications.

Our Stack

Languages:
Python, Rust, and Node/TypeScript, with React on the frontend
Data:
Postgresql, vector, and graph databases
Infra:
Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, across several cloud providers and customer VPCs
ML:
Self hosted models on multiple GPU providers and frontier APIs

______________________________________________________

Every role advertised by Calyptus is a live position we’re actively recruiting for. Some clients prefer to remain confidential during the early stages of the hiring process. When that’s the case, certain company details may be shared later in the process.

Why work with Calyptus?

Access opportunities with ambitious startups and high-growth technology companies

Honest feedback and clear communication throughout the hiring process
Long-term career support, not just a single job application

About Abridge

Founded in 2018, Abridge is the first AI-native clinician intelligence platform organized around the patient, built for clinicians, and designed to help health systems coordinate the clinical, financial, and evidence-based decisions for every moment of care. Powered by purpose-built AI for healthcare, Abridge connects patients, providers, payers, and life sciences companies. This year, the platform will support more than 100 million patient-clinician conversations across more than 300 of the largest and most complex health systems in the U.S. With deep workflow integration, the Abridge clinician intelligence platform has been validated to support encounters in 28+ languages across specialties and care settings.

Abridge is setting the industry standard for the responsible deployment of Al across health systems with continual and transparent Al evaluation. Clinical decision support references and cites gold-standard sources of evidence, and features like Linked Evidence map AI-generated documentation to source data, helping clinicians quickly trust and verify the output.

Abridge was awarded Best in KLAS for Ambient AI in 2025 and 2026, in addition to other accolades, including TIME Best Inventions of 2024 and 2025, CNBC Disruptor 2025, and Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies 2025.

We are a growing team of practicing clinicians, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to transform healthcare. We have offices located in San Francisco, New York, and Pittsburgh.

The Role

As an ML Infrastructure Engineer
at Abridge, you’ll play a pivotal role in building and optimizing the core inference infrastructure that powers our machine learning models. Your work will be instrumental in enhancing the scalability, efficiency, and performance of our AI-driven solutions. You will work with our Infrastructure and Research teams to build, deploy, optimize and orchestrate across our AI models.

What You'll Do

Design, deploy and maintain scalable Kubernetes clusters for AI model inference and training
Develop, optimize, and maintain ML model serving infrastructure, ensuring high-performance and low-latency.
Collaborate with ML and product teams to scale backend infrastructure for AI-driven products, focusing on model deployment, throughput optimization, and compute efficiency.
Optimize compute-heavy workflows and enhance GPU utilization for ML workloads.
Build a robust model API orchestration system
Collaborate with leadership to define and implement strategies for scaling infrastructure as the company grows, ensuring long-term efficiency and performance.

What You’ll Bring

5+ years of experience in building and deploying machine learning models in production environments.
Deep understanding of container orchestration and distributed systems architecture
Expertise in Kubernetes administration, including custom resource definitions, operators, and cluster management
Experience developing APIs and managing distributed systems for both batch and real-time workloads
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to interface between research and product engineering

Ideally, You Have

Expertise with model serving frameworks such as NVIDIA Triton Server, VLLM, TRT-LLM and so on.
Expertise with ML toolchains such as PyTorch, Tensorflow or distributed training and inference libraries.
Familiarity with GPU cluster management and CUDA optimization
Knowledge of infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible) and GitOps practices
Experience with container registries, image optimization, and multi-stage builds for ML workloads
Experience orchestrating across ASR models or LLM models for building various GenAI applications

Why Work at Abridge?

At Abridge, we’re transforming healthcare delivery experiences with generative AI, enabling clinicians and patients to connect in deeper, more meaningful ways. Our mission is clear: to power deeper understanding in healthcare. We’re driving real, lasting change, with millions of medical conversations processed each month.

Joining Abridge means stepping into a fast-paced, high-growth startup where your contributions truly make a difference. Our culture requires extreme ownership—every employee has the ability to (and is expected to) make an impact on our customers and our business.

Beyond individual impact, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a team of curious, high-achieving people in a supportive environment where success is shared, growth is constant, and feedback fuels progress. At Abridge, it’s not just what we do—it’s how we do it. Every decision is rooted in empathy, always prioritizing the needs of clinicians and patients.

We’re committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally. Whether it's flexible work hours, an inclusive culture, or ongoing learning opportunities, we are here to help you thrive and do the best work of your life.

If you are ready to make a meaningful impact alongside passionate people who care deeply about what they do, Abridge is the place for you.

How We Take Care Of Abridgers

Generous Time Off: 14 paid holidays, flexible PTO for salaried employees, and accrued time off for hourly employees
Comprehensive Health Plans: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for all full-time employees and their families.
Generous HSA Contribution: If you choose a High Deductible Health Plan, Abridge makes monthly contributions to your HSA.

... and much more!

jobs.description:
Research Engineer, Coding Agent Optimization Engine

San Francisco, in person
· Full-time · Entelligence

Coding agents ship more code every week, and they fail in repeatable ways: the same wrong assumption, the same missed test, the same review comment on PR after PR. Our Coding Agent Optimization Engine closes that loop. It mines agent sessions and PR review comments for failures, traces them to where the harness went wrong, and feeds the lessons back so the next session does not repeat them. It also routes every turn to the most efficient model that can solve it. It runs on live traffic from Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and API clients. We want a research engineer to make it measurably better at both.

Key Focus Areas Failure mining.
Captures coding-agent sessions and links them to the PRs they produced, then mines transcripts and review comments for errors, struggles and recurring root causes.
Learning loop.
Turns review findings into root-cause patterns and tested rules, and delivers them to the next agent session as guidance cards through CLI hooks.
Pre-PR judge.
A reviewer model checks an agent's change before the PR is opened, and the harness reports back what happened in each session.
Cost-aware routing.
Picks a difficulty tier per instruction turn and weights models by expected cost per solved task, with prompt-cache affinity, failover and per-org constraints.

What you will work on Failure attribution.
Given a session transcript and the review comments on its PR, find where the harness went wrong: missing context, a bad tool loop, a skipped check, the wrong model.
Prevention that measurably works.
Decide which lessons become rules, cards or judge checks, and prove with held-out data that they cut repeat findings without flooding agents with noise.
Evaluation.
Own the benchmark harness of record: replay real agentic tasks headlessly against competing harness configs and routing policies, and measure quality vs. cost honestly.
Engineering world model.
Build the comprehensive data layer connecting sessions, PRs, projects, errors and incidents. Leverage the world model to catch issues from happening in future sessions.
Cost and outcome modeling.
Turn measured usage, cache shares, latency and review outcomes into continuously refreshed model and harness parameters.

Your Background 3+ years building ML or LLM systems that run in production, or equivalent research experience with shipped code.
Strong Python and comfort reading a large production codebase.
Experiment design you can defend: held-out sets, variance, confidence intervals, leakage checks.
Hands-on experience with LLM APIs, agents or tool-use loops, and their failure modes.
Work on agent evaluation, failure analysis, LLM-as-judge or automated code review.
Work on routing, cascades, bandits or learning-to-defer.
Experience with LLM inference economics: prompt caching, batching, token pricing.
Built or maintained public evals (SWE-bench, Terminal-Bench style harnesses).
Published research or well-known open-source work in ML systems or developer tools.

Compensation and benefits

Base salary: $170,000 - $210,000
plus meaningful equity. Final offer depends on level and experience. Healthcare and a generous compute budget for experiments.

Master's degree or PhD in a related technical field

jobs.description:
Standard Job Description

As an AI/ML Research Engineer, you will work with guidance from project leaders and technical leads to:

Develop, integrate, and implement products to assist adding perception, motion/mission planning, controls, etc. functionality in LM products and platforms
Translate requirements and apply requirements to development code, integrating autonomy, AI or machine learning algorithms to LM products and platforms
Determine software methods to best acquire and execute knowledge
Implement algorithms into software to aide in development of systems which can recognize patterns and perform specific functions
Be responsible for various phases of developing and maintaining AI-based software from requirements generation, software design and development to integration, testing, troubleshooting and debugging, and implementation
Review test outcomes, conducts troubleshooting, and works to debug issues
Interface with other teams involved the development lifecycle for perception, mission and motion planning, simulation and modeling, testing, etc.

We are looking for someone with a strong problem solving mindset: ability to develop create solutions to difficult problems often requiring integration of conflicting and, at times, ambiguous or incomplete data on a fast paced schedule. You should have the demonstrated ability to effectively communicate complex design information, technical decision and issues to both highly technical and non-technical peers. We are also looking for the ability to build and maintain relationships, collaborate with others, engage in constructive conflict, and manage interpersonal dynamics. You should also be comfortable working in a fast paced and dynamic multi-disciplinary environment.

Standard Job Description
Focuses on research & development of technologies that enable and advance semi and fully autonomous systems for both defense and commercial customers. Serves as the algorithm expert with up-to-date knowledge on modern AI research and may be involved in the inception of ideas and drive the development cycles from research to test of prototypes for a major project or component of a major project.Researches and discovers improvements to machine learning and robotic algorithms; Drives advancements in techniques used in signal processing, computer vision (CV), and control systems; Develops AI algorithms for mission systems; Applies latest research on AI algorithms and trains machine learning / deep learning models to solve a variety of problems; Investigates and applies the latest machine learning and deep learning techniques; Optimizes the performance of AI algorithms, applications, and platforms; Develops and documents algorithm and implementation requirements; Develops prototypes that will enable autonomous functionality in LM products and platforms; Interfaces with other teams involved the development lifecycle for perception, mission and motion planning, simulation and modeling, testing, etc. Proficient in AI prompting as it applies to this position and practice.

Experience with advanced AI/ML techniques
Experience with AI/ML domain programming languages (e.g. Python, C++, Java, GO, MatLab, etc.)
Experience with communications protocols, e.g. RF and/or 5G

jobs.description:
Standard Job Description

AI Portfolio Solution Architect

Engineering Transformation is seeking an AI Portfolio Solution Architect to provide technical leadership for the Engineering Generative AI portfolio. This role will shape, build, and continuously improve secure, scalable AI solutions that advance Engineering ways of working.

What You Will Be Doing

In this role, you will serve as the technical authority across a rapidly evolving portfolio of Generative AI and agentic capabilities. You will define architecture, guide full-stack delivery, establish reusable engineering patterns, and ensure solutions are measurable, trustworthy, compliant with Responsible AI Governance and Ethics (RAGE) policies, and ready to scale across Engineering.

Key Responsibilities Will Include The Following

Define and evolve the technical architecture, roadmaps, and reference patterns for the Engineering Generative AI portfolio, including agentic workflows, retrieval, orchestration, integrations, and user experiences.
Lead hands-on full-stack solution design and development from prototype through production, spanning front-end applications, APIs, services, data connections, AI models, and deployment pipelines.
Establish composable, interoperable solution patterns with clear interfaces, versioned baselines, traceability, and reusable components across the portfolio.
Define the framework for transitioning rapid, AI-assisted and "vibe-coded" prototypes into mature, enterprise-deployable solutions, including approved development environments, architecture patterns, code quality, security, testing, documentation, ownership, and release criteria.
Evaluate emerging AI technologies, models, frameworks, and vendor capabilities; conduct technical trade studies, prototypes, and recommendations based on mission value, security, cost, performance, maintainability, and RAGE policy compliance.
Design human-centered, human-gated AI workflows that provide transparent outputs, source-grounded evidence, appropriate controls, and auditable decision support.
Embed RAGE requirements into solution architecture, development, testing, deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management; identify and address responsible-AI risks before release.
Partner with Engineering users, Data and AI Enablement, IT Applications, cybersecurity, and platform teams to translate priorities into deployable, supportable solutions.
Mentor technical contributors and provide technical direction to internal and partner delivery teams.

Further Information About This Opportunity

This role is fully remote. US Citizenship is required due to system access.

Experience serving as a technical lead, chief architect, solutions architect, or principal engineer for complex software, data, or AI-enabled systems.

Experience designing, developing, or integrating Generative AI, LLM, RAG, AI agent, orchestration, or machine-learning-enabled solutions.
Experience defining system architectures, interfaces, integration patterns, security controls, test approaches, and deployment strategies for enterprise applications.
Demonstrated ability to lead technical work across Engineering, IT, Data and AI Enablement, cybersecurity, vendors, and executive stakeholders.

Experience applying responsible AI, AI governance, model-risk management, or AI ethics requirements to AI-enabled solutions.
Experience with AI evaluation, observability, guardrails, automated testing, red teaming, regression testing, or continuous assurance practices.
Experience delivering AI-enabled engineering, digital-thread, Model-Based Systems Engineering, PLM, or other complex technical-domain solutions.
Experience building multi-agent systems, tool-using agents, workflow orchestration, knowledge retrieval, or semantic knowledge solutions.
Experience with cloud-native architectures, containers, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, event-driven systems, and API management.
Experience conducting technology trade studies and leading technical modernization or transformation initiatives in aerospace, defense, regulated, or classified environments.

jobs.title: Senior Solutions Architect, Embedded Physical AI
jobs.description:
Physical AI is redefining what robots can do, and embedded platforms are where that future becomes real! We are looking for a hands-on Solutions Architect with deep embedded systems expertise to serve as a technical anchor for NVIDIA’s Physical AI ecosystem. This role sits at the intersection of hardware bring-up, sensor integration, and deployment of next-generation robotics models. You will bridge pioneering research and real-world application engineering, working closely with customers and NVIDIA Engineering, Product, Sales, and Ecosystem teams to turn prototypes into production-grade, AI-accelerated robotics systems.

Are you are passionate about Robotics and ready to make a meaningful difference? If so, this role fits you!

What You'll Be Doing

Serve as the primary embedded systems expert for NVIDIA Physical AI partners using technologies such as Jetson, Holoscan, Isaac ROS, Isaac OS, GR00T.
Engage with customers to ensure smooth integration of production stacks, including real-time Linux environments, ROS 2, sensor pipelines, and edge AI models.
Deploy, profile, and optimize robotics foundation models (VLAs, World Models) on embedded computers and guide customers on tradeoffs
Translate customer requirements into practical NVIDIA-based architectures, and work closely with internal teams to feed field insights into product feedback and roadmap priorities.
Lead technical discussions, presentations, and hands-on workshops with key partners, while developing proof-of-concepts, and reference implementations.

What We Need To See

BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Robotics, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
5+ years of hands-on experience in embedded systems, including developing on NVIDIA Jetson, performance tuning, and system-level debugging.
Strong fluency in ROS 2 and background in deploying robotics autonomy stacks, and sim-to-real validation workflows.
Previous work integrating sensor pipelines such as cameras, LiDAR, and IMU
Proven expertise in AI model deployment, optimization, and GPU profiling on edge hardware, using SDKs like TensorRT
Outstanding communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for researchers, engineers, and business teams.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Hands-on experience with NVIDIA Robotics libraries such as Isaac ROS and cuVSLAM, as well as simulation frameworks like Isaac Sim and Isaac Lab
Familiarity with deploying and optimizing VLMs, VLAs (such as GR00T) or World Models (such as Cosmos) on edge platforms, including techniques like quantization, compression, and distillation.
Experience with camera and sensor software stacks such as NVIDIA’s HSB (Holoscan Sensor Bridge), V4L2, GMSL cameras, ISP tuning, or high-throughput video processing.
Prior experience with real-time and safety-aware embedded robotics systems in industries like autonomous vehicles or manufacturing.
Experience using agentic tooling to accelerate integration, debug, and build reference-implementation work.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary ranges for this position are:

152,000 USD – 241,500 USD for Level 3; and 184,000 USD – 287,500 USD for Level 4.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 3, 2026.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer - Ads Pangle - USDS
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

About the team
Pangle is the ad network of TikTok for Business, helping mobile developers accelerate growth, deliver engaging ad experiences, and maximize revenue by accessing TikTok's global advertising demand. Operating in more than 36 countries and regions, Pangle has built a strong reputation for driving measurable results for app partners worldwide.

As Pangle expands into the U.S. market, we're building our advertising platform from the ground up — tackling exciting new challenges in large-scale systems, optimization, and machine learning. Join us to shape the future of mobile monetization and grow your career in a fast-moving, global team.

Responsibilities
- Develop and optimize bidding algorithms and strategies across Pangle's ad delivery systems, including targeting, retrieval, ranking, and bidding models, with a focus on improving monetization efficiency and overall ad ROI.
- Improve the performance and efficiency of large-scale, online-learning–based deep models for real-time advertising applications.
- Apply advanced modeling techniques and strategic thinking to enhance attribution accuracy, delivery quality, and long-term ecosystem sustainability. Identify and drive innovative commercialization technologies and product solutions.
- Design, build, and iterate on core ad prediction models such as CTR (Click-Through Rate) and CVR (Conversion Rate) models.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualification(s):
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or related technical disciplines.
- 1+ years of hands-on experience with building and training complex and scalable machine learning systems.
- Strong Computer Science fundamentals (algorithms, data structures, software design) and problem-solving skills.
- Strong coding skills and a solid understanding of machine learning algorithms, particularly deep learning and ranking models.
- Experience leading or driving machine learning projects.

Preferred Qualification(s):
- Strong theoretical background in machine learning and deep learning, with proficiency in at least one major framework (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch).
- Demonstrated experience optimizing large-scale advertising systems, including bidding algorithms and delivery strategies. Familiarity with OCPC, OCPM, and AEO bidding models, and understanding of ad delivery mechanisms.
- Excellent teamwork and communication skills, with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to move projects forward independently.
- Strong business and data intuition, passion for tackling complex problems, and proven ability in abstraction, project execution, and innovation.

About USDS

TikTok USDS Joint Venture LLC is dedicated to the safety and security of millions of Americans who create, discover, and connect with what they love on the apps we operate. The Joint Venture has been established in compliance with the Executive Order signed by President Trump on September 25, 2025. Our foundation is a comprehensive data privacy and cybersecurity program we operate under defined safeguards to protect national security and secure U.S. user data, apps and the algorithm. We safeguard the U.S. content ecosystem, holding decision-making authority for trust and safety policies and moderation. USDS Joint Venture helps ensure Americans can continue to express their creativity, discover new hobbies and interests, and build thriving communities and businesses on a global scale.​
​
On-site presence across teams allows the company to operate with greater speed, alignment, and agility — especially in areas like real-time decision-making, team development, and integrated execution. As such, the company is shifting from a hybrid work model to a fully in-person schedule up to 5 days a week.​

Why Join Us

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.​
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​
​
Diversity & Inclusion​
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​

USDS Reasonable Accommodation

USDS is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at https://tinyurl.com/USDS-RA​

jobs.description:
About Aurasell
Aurasell is pioneering the world's first AI-native CRM platform. This full-featured Go-To-Market (GTM) application and true AI system of record is purpose-built for the new agentic era in business software. Founded in the post-2022 AI era, Aurasell eliminates the need for complex legacy frameworks, consolidating the GTM stack into a single, intelligent solution. Our platform automates routine tasks, unifies data, coaches best practices, and empowers teams to prioritize human-to-human selling. Aurasell has secured a $30 million Seed round from N47, Menlo Ventures, and Unusual Ventures.

The Forward Deployed Engineering Opportunity
We are building the founding Forward Deployed Engineering team, seeking the industry's top technology sales talent. FDEs at Aurasell are highly collaborative, cross-functional partners who utilize their sales and technology expertise across the organization. The core mission is to win deals, ensure customer enablement, and provide critical feedback and direction to the product team.

You will work directly with our founders and collaborate closely with top Account Executives, including alumni from industry-leading companies like Harness, Verkada, and Wiz.

We are hiring FDEs at various experience levels. We welcome those with existing FDE titles, as well as individuals with diverse GTM backgrounds, including Solutions Architects, Sales/Solutions Engineers, Customer Success Managers, and more.

- Strategic Partnership:
Partner closely with AEs to:
Develop and deliver compelling demonstrations.
Analyze and understand a prospect’s or customer’s legacy GTM technology.
Identify, organize, and articulate integration, migration, and product requirements.
Build tailored custom solutions using Aurasell’s workflow platform.

- Product & Strategy Leader:

Master the Aurasell product, including both the user interfaces and the powerful AI-native workflow engine.
Deeply understand customer goals, synthesize them into clear objectives, and communicate back to the product team to influence design and prioritization.
Keep a pulse on the broader AI and GTM industries, imagining and communicating new innovations. This includes building proof-of-concepts to educate the company on platform enhancements.
Be agile in communication—expect to discuss product architecture with a CTO, data security with a CIO, and GTM strategy with a CRO, potentially all in the same day.

- Implementation & Support:
Provide technical guidance and support throughout the implementation process, covering troubleshooting, optimization, and adoption.

- Internal Enablement:
Collaborate with account teams, product managers, and engineers to align platform capabilities with customer needs. Build internal GTM flywheels based on your experience, such as customer utilization analytics, internal tools, demo enablement, and broad company communications, to eliminate internal process toil.

As a Founding Member, you will help define, build, and own:
Technical components of a successful deal, from proof-of-value (POV) evaluations and mutual action plans to kickstart onboarding, rapidly enabling customers to become GTM Operators.
Demonstrations and enablement for our rapidly growing feature set.
Internal analytics to proactively identify emerging customer needs and issues.
Technological initiatives that accelerate product growth and adoption.

2+ years of professional experience in a technical sales or consultant role (e.g., FDE, SE, CSM).
A self-starter mentality with a proven history of hitting or exceeding goals.
An enthusiasm for building and applying skills related to AI.
A focus on solving real business problems, avoiding unnecessary technical detail.
Strong ability to collaborate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Adaptability to work in a dynamic and evolving business environment.
Ability and interest to travel up to 25% (with flexibility) for customer visits and field marketing events.

Prior experience in AI-native B2B technology companies.
Proficiency in a programming language (e.g., JavaScript, Python, Go).
Relevant Platforms:

Big data technology (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake, Elasticsearch).
Product analytics and monitoring (e.g., PostHog, Datadog).
AI-native coding platforms (e.g., Cursor, Windsurf).
GenAI technologies (e.g., RAG, LangChain).
API testing (e.g., Postman).

Legacy CRMs, ERPs, and ITSMs

Early-stage equity.
Comprehensive benefits package (health, dental, vision).
Remote-friendly flexibility.
Direct mentorship, deep enablement, and significant opportunities for leadership and growth across the Field organization, Product, Sales, or by defining and leading new initiatives as Aurasell evolves.

NVIDIA is building the world’s most groundbreaking and innovative accelerated computing platforms for AI and HPC. Because of our work, scientists, researchers, and engineers can push the boundaries of what’s possible. We pioneered a supercharged form of computing that powers everything from breakthrough AI research to the world’s fastest supercomputers.

We are seeking a highly motivated Senior Solutions Architect to join the NVIDIA Cloud Partners team with a focus on GPU, NVLink, and infrastructure design. As a Solutions Architect, you will serve as a key technical expert bridging NVIDIA’s ground breaking GPU and NVLink technology designs as well as all of our software solutions directly between engineering and field teams supporting customers with the most demanding requirements. Partner with NVIDIA Cloud Partners in GPU cluster design and networking and convey architecture and optimal process information for building next-generation architectures.

Support NPI customer deployments with new GPU/Networking architectures.

BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics, or related field (or equivalent experience).
8+ years of experience in cluster design, validation, and issue resolution, specifically on GPU and HPC clusters.
Proven expertise in designing large-scale distributed systems, AI clusters, or HPC infrastructure.
Ability to translate sophisticated engineering concepts into customer-ready documentation, diagrams, and reference material.
Expertise in driving customer/partner issues to a close with product and engineering teams.

jobs.description:
About Nscale

Nscale is the GPU cloud engineered for AI. We provide cost-effective, high-performance infrastructure for AI start-ups and large enterprise customers. Our GPU cloud bolsters technical capabilities and directly supports strategic business outcomes, including cost management, rapid innovation, and environmental responsibility.

We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an Nscaler, you’ll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work. If you join our team, you’ll be contributing to building the technology that powers the future.

About The Role

Nscale’s AI Infrastructure Operations team keeps one of the most demanding AI platforms in the industry running. At our scale, the design decisions we make this year set the failure modes we live with for the next five.

We’re looking for a Principal Site Reliability Engineer, Infrastructure Architecture
to be the architectural authority for how our platform is designed, connected, and recovered.

This is a design-first role. You will own the reference architecture for Nscale’s GPU, network, and control-plane platforms; decide where failure domains and trust boundaries sit; and make sure every major system we build has a known blast radius, a tested recovery path, and a clear owner. You'll work alongside the teams doing bring-ups, upgrades, and migrations, and you'll join major incidents when the cause turns out to be in the design. You'll be a peer to our existing architecture lead, not a backup; the two of you share ownership of both the design and the operating model, so neither one is a single point of failure.

What You'll Be Doing

Owning the end-to-end reference architecture for Nscale’s AI and HPC infrastructure: compute, network fabric, storage, control plane, and the core services underneath them
Designing multi-site and multi-region topologies, including failure domains, tenant isolation, and secure service enclaves for sovereign and hyperscale customers
Separating control plane from data plane by design, so that a management-layer outage never takes customer workloads down with it
Defining the target-state architecture and the multi-year roadmap to reach it, including what we retire, consolidate, or rebuild
Leading architecture reviews across Engineering, Network Operations, and Fleet Operations; writing and approving the RFCs and architecture decision records (ADRs) that other teams build against
Setting the architectural standards every new system must meet before it ships: SLOs, observability, capacity models, dependency maps, and documented failure modes
Running pre-mortems and red-team reviews on major designs to find single points of failure and hidden coupling before production does
Joining major incidents when the root cause is architectural, and follow the fix through to the design
Co-owning the operating model with the SRE team: operational readiness reviews (ORR), incident severity and post-incident review (PIR) standards, and production access and break-glass policy
Making sure the teams running each system can deploy, upgrade, and recover it without needing you in the room
Planning and reviewing site bring-ups, fleet upgrades, and migrations of live customer workloads
Running DR tests and game days so we know recovery works
Using incident and on-call data to decide what to redesign next
Mentoring senior engineers in systems design, so that architectural knowledge and decision-making never sit with a single person

About You

10+ years building and running large-scale production infrastructure, including on-call for systems you designed, and several years as a staff, principal, or architect-level engineer
A track record of architectures you designed that are running in production today; you can walk us through the tradeoffs, what broke, and what you would change
You've led major incidents and run large migrations or site bring-ups
Working knowledge of change management, staged rollouts, SLO-based alerting, and post-incident reviews
Deep expertise in distributed systems design: consistency models, consensus and replication, partition handling, and graceful degradation
Strong networking fundamentals at the design level, including L3 fabrics, BGP, EVPN/VXLAN, segmentation, and multi-site connectivity
Experience designing secure multi-tenant platforms: identity, PKI and secrets management, network isolation, and zero-trust boundaries
Clear technical writing; your design docs, RFCs, and ADRs hold up under scrutiny, and engineers can build directly from them
Proven ability to drive architectural decisions across teams without direct authority, including saying no to designs that will not hold up
Strong software engineering skills; you can prototype a design, review production code, and spot when an implementation has drifted from the intended architecture
Sound judgement when reliability, velocity, and cost pull in different directions, and the ability to explain the tradeoff to engineers and executives alike

Nice to Have

Architecting AI or HPC platforms at scale, including GPU clusters, InfiniBand or RoCE fabrics, and workload schedulers such as Slurm or Kubernetes-based GPU scheduling
Designing sovereign, regulated, or air-gapped cloud environments
Bare-metal and hybrid cloud architecture, including provisioning pipelines, a CMDB/DCIM as the source of truth, and hardware lifecycle automation
Observability architecture for high-cardinality, high-throughput environments
Kubernetes platform architecture across many clusters and sites
Structured design analysis methods such as failure mode and effects analysis (FMEA), threat modelling, or C4 diagrams
A history of step-change reliability or scalability gains that came from a redesign rather than a patch

On-Call and Pace

When an incident turns out to be a design problem, you'll be pulled in and you'll own the fix.

What We Can Offer You

At Nscale, you'll find a collaborative, supportive, and innovative environment
where your contributions spark real impact. We're building something extraordinary, and we want you at the core.

Highly competitive package (base + equity) with reviews every 12 months. 🚀
Join the fastest-growing tech startup, your chance to push boundaries, collaborate with brilliant minds, and make your mark on cutting-edge AI. ✨
Expect a dynamic progression plan tailored to your ambitions. Grow by trying new things, leading, challenging the status quo, and owning your impact, always with our full support.
Human-First Flexibility: We treat you as humans first. 🫶🏽 Our flexible workplace trusts Nscalers to deliver, giving you the autonomy to shape your day around life's moments.

Join our thriving remote-first team
. Geography is no barrier to impact or connection. We build seamless virtual collaboration, empowering you, wherever you work.

Equal Opportunities Statement

We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds.

If there’s anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know.

jobs.title: Research Scientist, Computational Imaging and Inverse Problems
jobs.description:
Company description

Vortex is building a handheld, volumetric, quantitative ultrasound imaging modality. Conventional ultrasound has reached its fundamental limits, so we looked outside medicine. Our core technology is Full-Waveform Inversion (FWI), adapted from seismic imaging in the oil and gas industry. We simulate how sound travels through tissue, compare the simulation with what we measured, and iteratively refine the tissue model until the two agree. Running on multi-GPU cloud compute, this reconstructs quantitative tissue properties that conventional ultrasound cannot see.
We recently completed a $12M funding round and are growing our US team.

Role description

This is a computational physics role. You will work on the physics-based reconstruction engine at the center of our product, reporting to the CTO. The work is wave-equation modeling, numerical simulation and PDE-constrained optimization, and you will implement and test your own ideas on real data. You will:
Develop and improve inversion methods for image quality, robustness and convergence speed.
Improve the accuracy and efficiency of our wave-propagation modeling and simulation.
Design objective functions, regularization and optimization strategies for large, ill-posed inverse problems.
Analyze and process raw ultrasound channel data and reconstructed images in the time, frequency and wavenumber domains.
Implement your methods in our GPU codebase and validate them through theory, simulation, phantom experiments and human scans.
Work closely with a small team of physicists, algorithm developers and software engineers in the US and Israel.

Please note: this is not a data science or machine learning position. Our reconstruction is driven by a physical model, not by a trained network. A background that is primarily in machine learning, deep learning or data science, without substantial work in physical modeling, numerical simulation or inverse problems, is not a fit for this role.

Qualifications

Required:
Strong academic or industry background in geophysics, computational physics, applied mathematics, acoustics, or a related field of physics or engineering, with work centered on physical modeling and inversion. A PhD is not required.
Research or industry experience in physics-based inverse problems, such as full-waveform inversion, seismic imaging, tomography or PDE-constrained optimization, including building the method yourself and not only running an existing package.
Experience writing numerical solvers for PDEs, for example finite-difference, finite-element or spectral methods for wave propagation.
Solid grounding in wave physics and numerical optimization, including adjoint-state and gradient-based methods.
Fluency in signal processing and Fourier analysis: you think comfortably in the frequency and wavenumber (k-space) domains, including sampling and aliasing, filtering, spectral analysis, dispersion and resolution.
Strong analytical ability and the habit of reasoning from first principles.
Strong coding skills in Python, and the ability to take an idea from derivation to working implementation quickly.
Curiosity about theory combined with a drive to solve real problems, and the ability to work independently as part of a team.

Strong advantages:
Full-waveform inversion in seismic exploration or ultrasound tomography.
Medical imaging or ultrasound physics.
GPU/CUDA development, C++ or high-performance computing.
Automatic differentiation frameworks (PyTorch) used for physical simulation and inversion.
Experience with raw sensor or array data, such as beamforming or array processing.
Machine learning used together with physics-based inversion, for example learned regularizers or priors. This is a plus on top of the requirements above, not a substitute for them.

FWI for medical ultrasound is a young field, and most of the interesting problems are still open. You will work on them with direct impact on a product heading toward FDA clearance, and see your work on scans of real patients.
To apply, email Uri Tal, CTO, at uri@vortex-imaging.com, or message him directly on LinkedIn. In your message, please describe briefly your experience with physical modeling, simulation or inverse problems.

jobs.description:
About The Role

Chime is looking for a Staff Data Scientist to establish the analytical direction for Product Marketing (PMM). As PMM’s dedicated analytics partner, you will help leaders forecast card demand, understand how members discover and activate Chime products, and connect member research with behavioral evidence to guide strategy and investment.

Your work will span three priorities. You will evolve card demand planning into a rigorous, repeatable forecasting process. You will build on existing research and analytical prototypes to establish reliable measurement of product activation and the member lifecycle, from account opening and first direct deposit through adoption, engagement, and retention. You will also partner with Research to translate qualitative findings into testable hypotheses and assess how broadly those findings apply across the member population.

As a Staff individual contributor, you will define ambiguous problems, set analytical standards, and deliver practical solutions. You will establish a prioritized roadmap with PMM leadership and partner with Product, Growth Analytics, Research, Card Operations, Finance, Data Engineering, and Enterprise Data & Metrics to turn analytical work into trusted data products and business decisions.

In this role, you can expect to

Build reliable card demand forecasting

Own the methodology for card demand forecasting, translating business planning needs into appropriate forecast horizons, granularity, refresh schedules, and performance measures.
Develop and evaluate time-series and driver-based models incorporating member growth, product launches, marketing activity, seasonality, replacement demand, and other relevant inputs.
Establish historical backtesting, benchmark comparisons, forecast bias and error monitoring, and uncertainty estimates. Investigate misses and continuously improve performance.
Partner with PMM, Card Operations, and Finance to translate forecasts into planning scenarios and assess implications for inventory, supplier lead times, cost, and service risk.
Build reproducible forecasting workflows with documented assumptions, stakeholder inputs, monitoring, and clear ownership.

Establish product activation and member lifecycle measurement

Define measurement frameworks for product discovery, activation, adoption, and sustained engagement across the member lifecycle, accounting for cohort, tenure, eligibility, and member segment.
Build on existing activation research and analytical prototypes to establish production-ready measurement, including cohort analyses anchored to milestones such as first qualifying direct deposit.
Evaluate proposed operating metrics, including Activated Member Rate, assessing product selection, thresholds, observation windows, sensitivity, and relationships with downstream engagement and retention.
Balance timely operational signals with cohort maturity and analytical validity. Distinguish predictive relationships from causal evidence and identify where further validation is needed.
Identify friction and drop-off across onboarding and cross-product journeys, size opportunities, and recommend actions to improve activation and sustained use.

Connect member research with quantitative evidence

Partner with User Research and PMM to translate qualitative findings about member needs, motivations, and barriers into testable hypotheses.
Use behavioral data, segmentation, funnel analysis, and statistical methods to assess the prevalence of research findings and how they differ across member groups.
Combine qualitative and quantitative evidence to guide positioning, messaging, onboarding, and product adoption strategies.

Lead analytical strategy and influence decisions

Set standards for forecasting, experimentation, metric validation, and interpretation within your scope.

Use AI tools to accelerate analysis, coding, and research synthesis while validating outputs and maintaining reproducibility.

A bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Operations Research, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
Extensive experience in analytics or data science, with a track record of independently setting analytical direction, solving ambiguous problems, and influencing decisions across multiple teams.
Hands-on experience building and operating demand forecasts used in business planning. You can explain how you selected methods, evaluated performance, quantified uncertainty, investigated errors, and incorporated stakeholder inputs.
Strong knowledge of time-series analysis, regression, statistical modeling, and forecasting evaluation, with sound judgment about when a simple approach is sufficient.
Experience measuring consumer product activation, adoption, engagement, and retention through cohort analysis, lifecycle measurement, and funnel analysis.
Strong experimentation and causal inference skills, including the ability to distinguish observational patterns, predictive signals, and evidence of incremental impact.
Expert SQL and advanced Python or R skills, with experience working with large datasets in cloud warehouses such as Snowflake.
Experience translating analytical prototypes into recurring workflows, reliable data models, and decision tools in partnership with data teams.
A track record of influencing senior leaders, establishing priorities, and building productive relationships across business and technical teams.
Clear communication with nontechnical audiences, including the ability to explain uncertainty and turn findings into actionable recommendations.
Comfort serving as a dedicated analytical partner while collaborating across a centralized Data Science and Analytics organization.

What You’ll Be Doing

Designing end2end solutions for Perception and AV stack to enable road network detections across various driving environments from complex intersections to rural curvy roads to multi-level highways.
Applied research and development of innovative deep learning models for lane graph construction, road boundary detection, traffic element recognition, and other static-world tasks.

Efforts will include data collection prioritization and planning, labeling prioritization, labeling efficiency optimization, so that value of data is maximized
Leverage data simulation and augmentation for solving extreme scenarios
Productize the developed perception solutions by meeting product requirements for safety, latency, and SW robustness.

Hands-on work experience in developing deep learning and algorithms to solve sophisticated real world problems, and proficiency in using deep learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch).
Experience in data-driven development and collaboration with data and ground truth teams.
Strong programming skills in python and/or C++.
Outstanding communication and teamwork skills as we work as a tightly-knit team, always discussing and learning from each other.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Proven expertise in developing generalizable perception solutions for autonomous driving or robotics using deep learning with cameras.
Hands-on experience in developing and deploying DNN-based solutions to embedded platforms for real time applications.
Proven expertise in deep learning backed up by technical publications in leading conferences/journals.
Expertise with Transformers, BEV architectures, and modern static-world perception techniques.Experience in working on similar online mapping and complex road detection problems is a big plus.

Intelligent machines powered by AI are no longer science fiction. GPU Deep Learning has made it possible for self-driving cars to learn, perceive, and reason about the world.
