new_jobs.description:
At Capital One, we are creating responsible and reliable AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been an industry leader in using machine learning to create real-time, personalized customer experiences. Our investments in technology infrastructure and world-class talent — along with our deep experience in machine learning — position us to be at the forefront of enterprises leveraging AI. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI & ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. We are committed to continuing to build world-class applied science and engineering teams to deliver our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build.

Team Description:

The Intelligent Foundations and Experiences (IFX) team is at the center of bringing our vision for AI at Capital One to life. We work hand-in-hand with our partners across the company to advance the state of the art in science and AI engineering, and we build and deploy proprietary solutions that are central to our business and deliver value to millions of customers. Our AI models and platforms empower teams across Capital One to enhance their products with the transformative power of AI, in responsible and scalable ways for the highest leverage impact.

What You’ll Do:

Partner with a cross-functional team of engineers, research scientists, technical program managers, and product managers to deliver AI-powered products that change how our associates work and how our customers interact with Capital One.
Design, develop, test, deploy, and support AI software components including foundation model training, large language model inference, agents and multi-agent workflows, similarity search, guardrails, model evaluation, experimentation, governance, and observability, etc.
Leverage a broad stack of Open Source and SaaS AI technologies such as AWS Ultraclusters, Huggingface, VectorDBs, PyTorch, and more.
Invent and introduce state-of-the-art foundation model optimization techniques to improve the performance — scalability, cost, latency, throughput — of large scale production AI systems.
Contribute to the technical vision and the long term roadmap of foundational AI systems at Capital One.
Set the technical direction for enterprise-wide AI architecture - unifying tooling, observability, and deployment standards across teams
Own the design and integration of model routing, caching, and orchestration systems that support hybrid and multi-model workloads
Champion responsible AI principles across all system design, embedding transparency, reproducibility, and fairness-by-design
Drive internal education, mentorship, and dissemination of best practices through architecture councils and AI guilds.

Capital One is open to hiring a Remote Employee for this opportunity.

You love to build systems, take pride in the quality of your work, and also share our passion to do the right thing. You want to work on problems that will help change banking for good
Passion for staying abreast of the latest research, and an ability to intuitively understand scientific publications and judiciously apply novel techniques in production

You are a resilient trailblazer who can forge new paths to achieve business goals when the route is unknown

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, AI, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields plus at least 8 years of experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies, or a Master's degree in Computer Science, AI, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields plus at least 6 years of experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies
At least 8 years of experience programming with Python, Go, Scala, CUDA, or Java

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience designing AI systems with tradeoff decisions around cost, latency, throughput and accuracy
8+ years of experience deploying scalable and responsible AI solutions on cloud platforms (e.g. AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, or equivalent private cloud)
Experience architecting, designing, developing, integrating, delivering, and supporting complex AI systems
Demonstrated ability to lead and mentor multiple engineering teams and influence cross-functional stakeholders up to the VP level
Experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies (e.g. LLM Inference, Similarity Search and VectorDBs, Guardrails, Memory) using Python, C++, C#, Java, CUDA, or Golang
Experience developing and applying state-of-the-art techniques for optimizing training and inference software to improve hardware utilization, latency, throughput, and cost
Experience in building agentic AI systems and agentic workflows
Passion for staying abreast of the latest AI research and AI systems, and judiciously apply novel techniques in production
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate complex AI concepts to peers
Proven track record of defining and operationalizing enterprise AI architecture standards, including data pipeline governance, observability and evaluation frameworks
Experience leading federated or multi-cloud AI strategies to maximize resilience, compliance and compute efficiency
Demonstrated success influencing research-to-production promotion processes - guiding model handoff, evaluation and productization
Experience defining north-star metrics for AI systems that balance business value, innovation velocity, cost, and ethical responsibility
Experience right-sizing models, instance counts, and hardware types given requirements (e.g., context length, token inputs, token outputs)

We are looking for a Senior / Principal Applied AI/ML Scientist who specializes in applying deep learning to physical systems, engineering simulations, and scientific computing.

This is not a conventional Machine Learning or Generative AI position. The focus is on developing AI models that learn from complex engineering simulation data and can predict physical behavior across different geometries, mesh structures, and engineering conditions.

We are particularly interested in professionals who have combined a background in computational physics, CFD, FEA, applied mathematics, or scientific computing with hands-on deep learning and scientific ML development.

You will develop physics-based surrogate models, work with neural operators and mesh-based architectures, and take models from research and experimentation into real engineering applications.

What You Will Work On

Design and train deep learning models that approximate computationally expensive engineering simulations.

Develop physics-based surrogate models using neural operators, Graph Neural Networks, and geometric deep learning.

Work with unstructured meshes, changing geometries, and variable point-count datasets rather than relying exclusively on fixed-grid or conventional image-based data.

Build and optimize model architectures, training pipelines, hyperparameters, and validation processes using Python and PyTorch.

Validate model predictions against ground-truth engineering simulations.

Collaborate with computational engineers to understand physical constraints, simulation data quality, and engineering requirements.

Work alongside data scientists, platform engineers, and customer engineering teams to deploy models into production engineering workflows.

Translate research developments in scientific ML into practical solutions for real engineering problems.

What Background Will Make You Successful?

We are particularly interested in candidates coming from one or more of these professional backgrounds:

Scientific Machine Learning / Physics-Informed ML Research.
Computational Physics or Applied Mathematics with deep learning experience.
CFD, FEA, or CAE engineering professionals who have transitioned into scientific ML.
Research Scientists specializing in neural operators, surrogate modeling, or geometric deep learning.
Applied AI/ML Scientists developing models for engineering simulations and physical systems.

Technical Expertise Required

Scientific Machine Learning & Model Development

Hands-on development of physics-based surrogate models.
Neural Operators and physics-informed machine learning.
Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), geometric deep learning, or mesh-based architectures.
Experience with unstructured meshes, varying geometries, and variable point counts across simulation samples.

Programming & Deep Learning

Strong Python and PyTorch experience.
Experience designing, training, tuning, and evaluating deep learning architectures.
Familiarity with JAX is beneficial.

Engineering & Simulation Knowledge

Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD).
Finite Element Analysis (FEA).
Thermal simulation and CAE workflows.
Scientific computing and numerical simulation.

Relevant Technologies

PhysicsNeMo, Transolver, MeshGraphNet, Neural Operators, Diffusion Models, GPU Computing, Distributed Training, and High-Performance Computing (HPC).

Experience & Education

Typically, 5+ years of hands-on applied ML experience involving engineering, scientific, or simulation data.
Strong experience building and deploying ML models in engineering or scientific applications.
Experience working directly with customers or internal engineering teams to deliver ML solutions.
Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline preferred.

Exceptional early-career candidates with a PhD and 1–2 years of directly relevant experience will also be considered.

Additional Information

San Mateo, CA is the preferred work location, with five days per week in the office.
Exceptional candidates unable to work on-site may be considered for remote arrangements.
Occasional travel to customer sites is expected.

Who Should Apply?

If your experience combines engineering simulation, scientific computing, and hands-on machine learning model development, we would like to hear from you.

We are particularly interested in professionals who have moved beyond conventional ML applications and have built models that learn the underlying behavior of physical systems.

Please submit your updated resume highlighting your experience with scientific ML, simulation datasets, surrogate modeling, neural operators, and engineering applications.

new_jobs.title: Research Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Research Engineer, Coding Agent Optimization Engine

San Francisco, in person
· Full-time · Entelligence

Coding agents ship more code every week, and they fail in repeatable ways: the same wrong assumption, the same missed test, the same review comment on PR after PR. Our Coding Agent Optimization Engine closes that loop. It mines agent sessions and PR review comments for failures, traces them to where the harness went wrong, and feeds the lessons back so the next session does not repeat them. It also routes every turn to the most efficient model that can solve it. It runs on live traffic from Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and API clients. We want a research engineer to make it measurably better at both.

Key Focus Areas Failure mining.
Captures coding-agent sessions and links them to the PRs they produced, then mines transcripts and review comments for errors, struggles and recurring root causes.
Learning loop.
Turns review findings into root-cause patterns and tested rules, and delivers them to the next agent session as guidance cards through CLI hooks.
Pre-PR judge.
A reviewer model checks an agent's change before the PR is opened, and the harness reports back what happened in each session.
Cost-aware routing.
Picks a difficulty tier per instruction turn and weights models by expected cost per solved task, with prompt-cache affinity, failover and per-org constraints.

What you will work on Failure attribution.
Given a session transcript and the review comments on its PR, find where the harness went wrong: missing context, a bad tool loop, a skipped check, the wrong model.
Prevention that measurably works.
Decide which lessons become rules, cards or judge checks, and prove with held-out data that they cut repeat findings without flooding agents with noise.
Evaluation.
Own the benchmark harness of record: replay real agentic tasks headlessly against competing harness configs and routing policies, and measure quality vs. cost honestly.
Engineering world model.
Build the comprehensive data layer connecting sessions, PRs, projects, errors and incidents. Leverage the world model to catch issues from happening in future sessions.
Cost and outcome modeling.
Turn measured usage, cache shares, latency and review outcomes into continuously refreshed model and harness parameters.

Your Background 3+ years building ML or LLM systems that run in production, or equivalent research experience with shipped code.
Strong Python and comfort reading a large production codebase.
Experiment design you can defend: held-out sets, variance, confidence intervals, leakage checks.
Hands-on experience with LLM APIs, agents or tool-use loops, and their failure modes.
Work on agent evaluation, failure analysis, LLM-as-judge or automated code review.
Work on routing, cascades, bandits or learning-to-defer.
Experience with LLM inference economics: prompt caching, batching, token pricing.
Built or maintained public evals (SWE-bench, Terminal-Bench style harnesses).
Published research or well-known open-source work in ML systems or developer tools.

Compensation and benefits

Base salary: $170,000 - $210,000
plus meaningful equity. Final offer depends on level and experience. Healthcare and a generous compute budget for experiments.

new_jobs.description:
Standard Job Description

AI Portfolio Solution Architect

Engineering Transformation is seeking an AI Portfolio Solution Architect to provide technical leadership for the Engineering Generative AI portfolio. This role will shape, build, and continuously improve secure, scalable AI solutions that advance Engineering ways of working.

What You Will Be Doing

In this role, you will serve as the technical authority across a rapidly evolving portfolio of Generative AI and agentic capabilities. You will define architecture, guide full-stack delivery, establish reusable engineering patterns, and ensure solutions are measurable, trustworthy, compliant with Responsible AI Governance and Ethics (RAGE) policies, and ready to scale across Engineering.

Key Responsibilities Will Include The Following

Define and evolve the technical architecture, roadmaps, and reference patterns for the Engineering Generative AI portfolio, including agentic workflows, retrieval, orchestration, integrations, and user experiences.
Lead hands-on full-stack solution design and development from prototype through production, spanning front-end applications, APIs, services, data connections, AI models, and deployment pipelines.
Establish composable, interoperable solution patterns with clear interfaces, versioned baselines, traceability, and reusable components across the portfolio.
Define the framework for transitioning rapid, AI-assisted and "vibe-coded" prototypes into mature, enterprise-deployable solutions, including approved development environments, architecture patterns, code quality, security, testing, documentation, ownership, and release criteria.
Evaluate emerging AI technologies, models, frameworks, and vendor capabilities; conduct technical trade studies, prototypes, and recommendations based on mission value, security, cost, performance, maintainability, and RAGE policy compliance.
Design human-centered, human-gated AI workflows that provide transparent outputs, source-grounded evidence, appropriate controls, and auditable decision support.
Embed RAGE requirements into solution architecture, development, testing, deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management; identify and address responsible-AI risks before release.
Partner with Engineering users, Data and AI Enablement, IT Applications, cybersecurity, and platform teams to translate priorities into deployable, supportable solutions.
Mentor technical contributors and provide technical direction to internal and partner delivery teams.

Further Information About This Opportunity

This role is fully remote. US Citizenship is required due to system access.

Basic Qualifications

Experience serving as a technical lead, chief architect, solutions architect, or principal engineer for complex software, data, or AI-enabled systems.
Demonstrated hands-on full-stack software engineering experience, including modern web applications, APIs, backend services, cloud platforms, and DevSecOps practices.
Experience designing, developing, or integrating Generative AI, LLM, RAG, AI agent, orchestration, or machine-learning-enabled solutions.
Experience defining system architectures, interfaces, integration patterns, security controls, test approaches, and deployment strategies for enterprise applications.
Demonstrated ability to lead technical work across Engineering, IT, Data and AI Enablement, cybersecurity, vendors, and executive stakeholders.
US Citizenship is required due to system access.

Desired Skills

Experience applying responsible AI, AI governance, model-risk management, or AI ethics requirements to AI-enabled solutions.
Experience with AI evaluation, observability, guardrails, automated testing, red teaming, regression testing, or continuous assurance practices.
Experience delivering AI-enabled engineering, digital-thread, Model-Based Systems Engineering, PLM, or other complex technical-domain solutions.
Experience building multi-agent systems, tool-using agents, workflow orchestration, knowledge retrieval, or semantic knowledge solutions.
Experience with cloud-native architectures, containers, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, event-driven systems, and API management.
Experience conducting technology trade studies and leading technical modernization or transformation initiatives in aerospace, defense, regulated, or classified environments.

new_jobs.title: Principal Site Reliability Engineer, Infrastructure Architecture- AI Infrastructure Operations
new_jobs.description:
About Nscale

Nscale is the GPU cloud engineered for AI. We provide cost-effective, high-performance infrastructure for AI start-ups and large enterprise customers. Nscale enables AI-focused companies to achieve superior results by reducing the complexity of AI development. Our GPU cloud bolsters technical capabilities and directly supports strategic business outcomes, including cost management, rapid innovation, and environmental responsibility.

We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an Nscaler, you’ll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work. If you join our team, you’ll be contributing to building the technology that powers the future.

About The Role

Nscale’s AI Infrastructure Operations team keeps one of the most demanding AI platforms in the industry running. At our scale, the design decisions we make this year set the failure modes we live with for the next five.

We’re looking for a Principal Site Reliability Engineer, Infrastructure Architecture
to be the architectural authority for how our platform is designed, connected, and recovered.

This is a design-first role. You will own the reference architecture for Nscale’s GPU, network, and control-plane platforms; decide where failure domains and trust boundaries sit; and make sure every major system we build has a known blast radius, a tested recovery path, and a clear owner. You'll work alongside the teams doing bring-ups, upgrades, and migrations, and you'll join major incidents when the cause turns out to be in the design. You'll be a peer to our existing architecture lead, not a backup; the two of you share ownership of both the design and the operating model, so neither one is a single point of failure.

What You'll Be Doing

Owning the end-to-end reference architecture for Nscale’s AI and HPC infrastructure: compute, network fabric, storage, control plane, and the core services underneath them
Designing multi-site and multi-region topologies, including failure domains, tenant isolation, and secure service enclaves for sovereign and hyperscale customers
Separating control plane from data plane by design, so that a management-layer outage never takes customer workloads down with it
Defining the target-state architecture and the multi-year roadmap to reach it, including what we retire, consolidate, or rebuild
Leading architecture reviews across Engineering, Network Operations, and Fleet Operations; writing and approving the RFCs and architecture decision records (ADRs) that other teams build against
Setting the architectural standards every new system must meet before it ships: SLOs, observability, capacity models, dependency maps, and documented failure modes
Running pre-mortems and red-team reviews on major designs to find single points of failure and hidden coupling before production does
Joining major incidents when the root cause is architectural, and follow the fix through to the design
Co-owning the operating model with the SRE team: operational readiness reviews (ORR), incident severity and post-incident review (PIR) standards, and production access and break-glass policy
Making sure the teams running each system can deploy, upgrade, and recover it without needing you in the room
Planning and reviewing site bring-ups, fleet upgrades, and migrations of live customer workloads
Running DR tests and game days so we know recovery works
Using incident and on-call data to decide what to redesign next
Mentoring senior engineers in systems design, so that architectural knowledge and decision-making never sit with a single person

About You

10+ years building and running large-scale production infrastructure, including on-call for systems you designed, and several years as a staff, principal, or architect-level engineer

new_jobs.title: Research Scientist, Computational Imaging and Inverse Problems
new_jobs.description:
Company description

Vortex is building a handheld, volumetric, quantitative ultrasound imaging modality. Conventional ultrasound has reached its fundamental limits, so we looked outside medicine. Our core technology is Full-Waveform Inversion (FWI), adapted from seismic imaging in the oil and gas industry. We simulate how sound travels through tissue, compare the simulation with what we measured, and iteratively refine the tissue model until the two agree. Running on multi-GPU cloud compute, this reconstructs quantitative tissue properties that conventional ultrasound cannot see.
We recently completed a $12M funding round and are growing our US team.

Role description

This is a computational physics role. You will work on the physics-based reconstruction engine at the center of our product, reporting to the CTO. The work is wave-equation modeling, numerical simulation and PDE-constrained optimization, and you will implement and test your own ideas on real data. You will:
Develop and improve inversion methods for image quality, robustness and convergence speed.
Improve the accuracy and efficiency of our wave-propagation modeling and simulation.
Design objective functions, regularization and optimization strategies for large, ill-posed inverse problems.
Analyze and process raw ultrasound channel data and reconstructed images in the time, frequency and wavenumber domains.
Implement your methods in our GPU codebase and validate them through theory, simulation, phantom experiments and human scans.
Work closely with a small team of physicists, algorithm developers and software engineers in the US and Israel.

Please note: this is not a data science or machine learning position. Our reconstruction is driven by a physical model, not by a trained network. A background that is primarily in machine learning, deep learning or data science, without substantial work in physical modeling, numerical simulation or inverse problems, is not a fit for this role.

Qualifications

Required:
Strong academic or industry background in geophysics, computational physics, applied mathematics, acoustics, or a related field of physics or engineering, with work centered on physical modeling and inversion. A PhD is not required.
Research or industry experience in physics-based inverse problems, such as full-waveform inversion, seismic imaging, tomography or PDE-constrained optimization, including building the method yourself and not only running an existing package.
Experience writing numerical solvers for PDEs, for example finite-difference, finite-element or spectral methods for wave propagation.
Solid grounding in wave physics and numerical optimization, including adjoint-state and gradient-based methods.
Fluency in signal processing and Fourier analysis: you think comfortably in the frequency and wavenumber (k-space) domains, including sampling and aliasing, filtering, spectral analysis, dispersion and resolution.
Strong analytical ability and the habit of reasoning from first principles.
Strong coding skills in Python, and the ability to take an idea from derivation to working implementation quickly.
Curiosity about theory combined with a drive to solve real problems, and the ability to work independently as part of a team.

Strong advantages:
Full-waveform inversion in seismic exploration or ultrasound tomography.
Medical imaging or ultrasound physics.
GPU/CUDA development, C++ or high-performance computing.
Automatic differentiation frameworks (PyTorch) used for physical simulation and inversion.
Experience with raw sensor or array data, such as beamforming or array processing.
Machine learning used together with physics-based inversion, for example learned regularizers or priors. This is a plus on top of the requirements above, not a substitute for them.

FWI for medical ultrasound is a young field, and most of the interesting problems are still open. You will work on them with direct impact on a product heading toward FDA clearance, and see your work on scans of real patients.
To apply, email Uri Tal, CTO, at uri@vortex-imaging.com, or message him directly on LinkedIn. In your message, please describe briefly your experience with physical modeling, simulation or inverse problems.

About The Role

Chime is looking for a Staff Data Scientist to establish the analytical direction for Product Marketing (PMM). As PMM’s dedicated analytics partner, you will help leaders forecast card demand, understand how members discover and activate Chime products, and connect member research with behavioral evidence to guide strategy and investment.

Your work will span three priorities. You will evolve card demand planning into a rigorous, repeatable forecasting process. You will build on existing research and analytical prototypes to establish reliable measurement of product activation and the member lifecycle, from account opening and first direct deposit through adoption, engagement, and retention. You will also partner with Research to translate qualitative findings into testable hypotheses and assess how broadly those findings apply across the member population.

As a Staff individual contributor, you will define ambiguous problems, set analytical standards, and deliver practical solutions. You will establish a prioritized roadmap with PMM leadership and partner with Product, Growth Analytics, Research, Card Operations, Finance, Data Engineering, and Enterprise Data & Metrics to turn analytical work into trusted data products and business decisions.

In this role, you can expect to

Build reliable card demand forecasting

Own the methodology for card demand forecasting, translating business planning needs into appropriate forecast horizons, granularity, refresh schedules, and performance measures.
Develop and evaluate time-series and driver-based models incorporating member growth, product launches, marketing activity, seasonality, replacement demand, and other relevant inputs.
Establish historical backtesting, benchmark comparisons, forecast bias and error monitoring, and uncertainty estimates. Investigate misses and continuously improve performance.
Partner with PMM, Card Operations, and Finance to translate forecasts into planning scenarios and assess implications for inventory, supplier lead times, cost, and service risk.
Build reproducible forecasting workflows with documented assumptions, stakeholder inputs, monitoring, and clear ownership.

Establish product activation and member lifecycle measurement

Identify friction and drop-off across onboarding and cross-product journeys, size opportunities, and recommend actions to improve activation and sustained use.

A bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Operations Research, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

Strong knowledge of time-series analysis, regression, statistical modeling, and forecasting evaluation, with sound judgment about when a simple approach is sufficient.
Experience measuring consumer product activation, adoption, engagement, and retention through cohort analysis, lifecycle measurement, and funnel analysis.
Strong experimentation and causal inference skills, including the ability to distinguish observational patterns, predictive signals, and evidence of incremental impact.
Expert SQL and advanced Python or R skills, with experience working with large datasets in cloud warehouses such as Snowflake.
Experience translating analytical prototypes into recurring workflows, reliable data models, and decision tools in partnership with data teams.
A track record of influencing senior leaders, establishing priorities, and building productive relationships across business and technical teams.

Comfort serving as a dedicated analytical partner while collaborating across a centralized Data Science and Analytics organization.

Job Description

Senior Agentic AI Enablement Engineer

Department: S&S Digital AI Engineering & Automation | Location: Remote, United States

Reports to: AVP, AI Engineering & Automation

Position Summary

Crum & Forster is building an enterprise agentic AI capability across underwriting, claims, legal and compliance, and corporate operations, with engineering teams.

We are seeking a Senior Agentic AI Enablement Engineer to design, build, and ship agentic AI solutions hands-on. You will turn validated solution designs into working agents, build the reference implementations our engineering pods build on, and work embedded alongside our AI execution pods to accelerate production delivery.

This is a hands-on engineering role. Most of your time will be spent writing production-quality code: multi-agent orchestration, retrieval pipelines, tool integrations, and evaluation harnesses on AWS. You will work closely with the Principal AI Engineer, who sets architecture and technical standards, and you will be the US-based build anchor for our agentic platform.

Why This Role

You will build the agentic AI systems at the heart of C&F’s AI transformation, hands-on and on a modern AWS stack, while shaping how our engineering teams build. The role offers a clear growth path toward Principal AI Engineer as our AI capability scales.

What You Will Do

Agentic Solution Engineering

Build multi-agent workflows across planner, retrieval, tool-calling, and validation steps, including context engineering, agent memory, state management, and escalation paths.
Implement autonomy boundaries, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, deterministic guardrails, and audit trails in code.
Develop and integrate tools and services through Model Context Protocol (MCP) and enterprise APIs, including policy administration, claims, and document systems.

Retrieval & Grounding

Build retrieval pipelines over unstructured submissions, claims files, and financial records: document parsing, chunking, embeddings, hybrid search, and reranking.
Tune retrieval quality and grounding using measurable metrics such as hit rate, MRR, and citation accuracy.

Prototyping & Reference Implementations

Rapidly prototype agents on Amazon Bedrock and Bedrock AgentCore to prove feasibility before production build.
Build reusable reference implementations, SDK components, and patterns that the execution pods adopt and extend.
Harden successful prototypes into production-ready components to the engineering standards set by the Principal AI Engineer.

Evaluation, Observability & Reliability

Build evaluation harnesses with golden datasets, LLM-as-judge scoring, and regression gates that run in CI/CD before release.
Instrument agents with tracing, observability, latency and cost monitoring, and work with the reliability engineering pod on production quality.

Delivery Partnership

Work embedded alongside the AI execution pods: pair on hard problems, review code, and unblock delivery.
Contribute to technical design reviews and architecture decisions with the Principal AI Engineer.
Mentor engineers on agentic engineering practices across US and India teams.

8+ years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years building Generative AI or agentic AI solutions, with at least one in production.
Strong Python engineering skills and experience writing production-quality, tested code.
Hands-on experience with LLM orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, or equivalent, including tool calling and multi-step agent workflows.

Experience implementing LLM evaluation and testing approaches.
Solid grounding in API design, CI/CD, and secure development practices.

Experience building or deploying MCP servers and tool integrations.
Experience with agent observability and tracing tools such as LangSmith or OpenTelemetry.
Experience with TypeScript or another modern language in addition to Python.
Experience in Property & Casualty insurance or another regulated industry.

Working agentic prototypes that prove feasibility quickly and move into production build.
Reference implementations and reusable components adopted across the AI
Agents released with evaluation gates, observability, and controls built in from the start.
Measurably faster delivery from the engineering teams you work alongside.

Standard Job Description

The AI Research & Enterprise Solutions (AIRES) team within Lockheed Martin’s Data & AI Enablement organization(D&Ae) creates tailored, production‑grade AI solutions that enable success across the corporation. In this role you will partner with internal stakeholders to translate complex requirements into end‑to‑end machine‑learning pipelines, integrate large‑language‑model capabilities, and drive research‑focused innovations that accelerate AI adoption enterprise‑wide. Your expertise in Python, the data‑science lifecycle, deep‑learning fundamentals, and emerging generative‑AI technologies will empower you to deliver high‑impact, mission‑critical solutions that generate measurable value for Lockheed Martin.

Responsible for developing, integrating, and deploying autonomy and artificial intelligence algorithms for mission systems, supporting the technology development life cycle from requirements generation through development, integration, and testing, as well as research in some organizations.Develops, integrates, and implements algorithms to enable perception, motion/mission planning, controls, etc. functionality in LM products and platforms; Translates requirements and applies requirements to development code, integrating autonomy, AI or machine learning algorithms to LM products and platforms; Determines software methods to best acquire and execute knowledge; Implements algorithms into software to train systems to recognize patterns and perform specific functions; Responsible for various phases of developing and maintaining autonomy software from requirements generation, software design and development to integration, testing, troubleshooting and debugging, and implementation; Review test outcomes, conducts troubleshooting, and works to debug issues; Develops human-machine interface scenarios, breaking missions into tasks; Documents interface requirements and implements human-machine interfaces

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, AI/ML, or a related discipline.
Proficiency in Python – write clean, well‑documented code and explain your logic.
Knowledge of the data‑science lifecycle, big‑data concepts, deep‑learning fundamentals, and reinforcement‑learning ideas.
Basic awareness of Generative AI capabilities such as large‑language models (LLMs)
Demonstrated initiative and research mindset – comfortable navigating documentation, exploring new tools, and proposing ideas.
Strong problem‑solving and communication skills; able to work with internal customers to gather requirements and provide clear status updates.

Desired Skills

Experience with LLM frameworks or APIs (e.g., LangChain, OpenAI, Cohere).
Exposure to MLOps fundamentals: CI/CD pipelines, model versioning, monitoring, Docker/Kubernetes.
Knowledge‑graph or ontology work (SPARQL, embeddings, graph‑based feature engineering).
Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and OpenShift.
Ability to quickly absorb new tools, applications, or approaches from documentation or public repositories and contribute ideas to the team.
Research‑oriented mindset – conducting industry/academic research, networking with peers, and surfacing innovative strategies.
Breadth of interest or experience with diverse data‑application domains (structured, unstructured, time‑series, sensor, etc.).
Experience with Git fundamentals (branching, merging, pull‑requests, basic workflow conventions).
Understanding of RESTful APIs and ability to integrate them into data pipelines.
Basic familiarity with Docker (or comparable container technology).

new_jobs.description:
Standard Job Description

Team Overview

The Rotary Mission Systems (RMS) AI Hub team, within Lockheed Martin's Data & AI Enablement (D&AE) organization, creates tailored, production-grade AI solutions that enable the functions and lines of business across RMS. The team's core capabilities span descriptive data analysis, predictive machine learning, and cognitive AI products - including computer vision, natural language processing, and generative AI. In this role, you will partner with internal stakeholders to translate complex requirements into end-to-end machine-learning pipelines, integrate large-language-model (LLM) capabilities, and drive innovations that accelerate AI value realization within the business area. Your expertise in Python, the data-science lifecycle, deep-learning fundamentals, and emerging AI technologies will empower you to deliver high-impact solutions that generate measurable value for RMS and Lockheed Martin.

Key Responsibilities

Translate business problems into AI-driven solution architectures.
Build, fine-tune, and integrate LLMs and complementary AI models into new and existing RMS applications.
Create test plans, conduct integration testing, and deploy solutions using CI/CD pipelines.
Document designs and collaborate with change management to ensure smooth user adoption.
Monitor deployed solutions and drive continuous improvement to keep pace with evolving business needs.

By delivering robust, production-grade AI pipelines and intuitive interfaces, you will enhance efficiency across RMS functions and empower teams to better support Lockheed Martin's customers.

Standard Job Description For A/AI Machine Learning Engineering Senior

Responsible for developing, integrating, and deploying autonomy and artificial intelligence algorithms for mission systems, supporting the technology development life cycle from requirements generation through development, integration, and testing, as well as research in some organizations.Develops, integrates, and implements algorithms to enable perception, motion/mission planning, controls, etc. functionality in LM products and platforms; Translates requirements and applies requirements to development code, integrating autonomy, AI or machine learning algorithms to LM products and platforms; Determines software methods to best acquire and execute knowledge; Implements algorithms into software to train systems to recognize patterns and perform specific functions; Responsible for various phases of developing and maintaining autonomy software from requirements generation, software design and development to integration, testing, troubleshooting and debugging, and implementation; Review test outcomes, conducts troubleshooting, and works to debug issues; Develops human-machine interface scenarios, breaking missions into tasks; Documents interface requirements and implements human-machine interfaces

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, AI/ML, or a related discipline.
Proficiency in Python - write clean, well-documented code and explain your logic.
Knowledge of the data-science lifecycle, big-data concepts, deep-learning fundamentals, and reinforcement-learning ideas.
Demonstrated success with Generative AI capabilities such as large-language models (LLMs)
Demonstrated initiative and research mindset - comfortable navigating documentation, exploring new tools, and proposing ideas with minimal supervision.
Strong problem-solving and communication skills; able to work with internal customers to gather requirements and provide clear status updates.
Understanding of RESTful APIs and ability to integrate them into data pipelines.

Desired Skills

Experience with LLM frameworks or APIs (e.g., LangChain, OpenAI, Cohere).
Exposure to MLOps fundamentals: CI/CD pipelines, model versioning, monitoring, Docker/Kubernetes.
Knowledge-graph or ontology work (SPARQL, embeddings, graph-based feature engineering).
Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and OpenShift.
Ability to quickly absorb new tools, applications, or approaches from documentation or public repositories and contribute ideas to the team.
Research-oriented mindset - conducting industry/academic research, networking with peers, and surfacing innovative strategies.
Breadth of interest or experience with diverse data-application domains (structured, unstructured, time-series, sensor, etc.).
Experience with Git fundamentals (branching, merging, pull-requests, basic workflow conventions).
Basic familiarity with Docker (or comparable container technology).

new_jobs.description:
Standard Job Description

Team Overview

The Rotary Mission Systems (RMS) AI Hub team, within Lockheed Martin's Data & AI Enablement (D&AE) organization, creates tailored, production-grade AI solutions that enable the functions and lines of business across RMS. The team's core capabilities span descriptive data analysis, predictive machine learning, and cognitive AI products - including computer vision, natural language processing, and generative AI. In this role, you will partner with internal stakeholders to translate complex requirements into end-to-end machine-learning pipelines, integrate large-language-model (LLM) capabilities, and drive innovations that accelerate AI value realization within the business area. Your expertise in Python, the data-science lifecycle, deep-learning fundamentals, and emerging AI technologies will empower you to deliver high-impact solutions that generate measurable value for RMS and Lockheed Martin.

Key Responsibilities

Translate business problems into AI-driven solution architectures.
Build, fine-tune, and integrate LLMs and complementary AI models into new and existing RMS applications.
Create test plans, conduct integration testing, and deploy solutions using CI/CD pipelines.
Document designs and collaborate with change management to ensure smooth user adoption.
Monitor deployed solutions and drive continuous improvement to keep pace with evolving business needs.

By delivering robust, production-grade AI pipelines and intuitive interfaces, you will enhance efficiency across RMS functions and empower teams to better support Lockheed Martin's customers.

Standard Job Description For A/AI Machine Learning Engineering Senior

Responsible for developing, integrating, and deploying autonomy and artificial intelligence algorithms for mission systems, supporting the technology development life cycle from requirements generation through development, integration, and testing, as well as research in some organizations.Develops, integrates, and implements algorithms to enable perception, motion/mission planning, controls, etc. functionality in LM products and platforms; Translates requirements and applies requirements to development code, integrating autonomy, AI or machine learning algorithms to LM products and platforms; Determines software methods to best acquire and execute knowledge; Implements algorithms into software to train systems to recognize patterns and perform specific functions; Responsible for various phases of developing and maintaining autonomy software from requirements generation, software design and development to integration, testing, troubleshooting and debugging, and implementation; Review test outcomes, conducts troubleshooting, and works to debug issues; Develops human-machine interface scenarios, breaking missions into tasks; Documents interface requirements and implements human-machine interfaces

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, AI/ML, or a related discipline.
Proficiency in Python - write clean, well-documented code and explain your logic.
Knowledge of the data-science lifecycle, big-data concepts, deep-learning fundamentals, and reinforcement-learning ideas.
Demonstrated success with Generative AI capabilities such as large-language models (LLMs)
Demonstrated initiative and research mindset - comfortable navigating documentation, exploring new tools, and proposing ideas with minimal supervision.
Strong problem-solving and communication skills; able to work with internal customers to gather requirements and provide clear status updates.
Understanding of RESTful APIs and ability to integrate them into data pipelines.

Desired Skills

Experience with LLM frameworks or APIs (e.g., LangChain, OpenAI, Cohere).
Exposure to MLOps fundamentals: CI/CD pipelines, model versioning, monitoring, Docker/Kubernetes.
Knowledge-graph or ontology work (SPARQL, embeddings, graph-based feature engineering).
Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and OpenShift.
Ability to quickly absorb new tools, applications, or approaches from documentation or public repositories and contribute ideas to the team.
Research-oriented mindset - conducting industry/academic research, networking with peers, and surfacing innovative strategies.
Breadth of interest or experience with diverse data-application domains (structured, unstructured, time-series, sensor, etc.).
Experience with Git fundamentals (branching, merging, pull-requests, basic workflow conventions).
Basic familiarity with Docker (or comparable container technology).

Includes metropolitan areas such as Camden, AR; Lexington, KY; Lufkin, TX; etc.

As the Operations AI Engineer Senior - Level 3 you will be responsible for leading exploratory research and analysis that identifies novel patterns in complex data, applying statistical methods to validate hypotheses, and delivering business‑focused insights.

Develop and validate predictive models using advanced statistical, deep‑learning, and optimization techniques.
Design and implement high‑performance computing solutions (GPU, distributed, cloud) to accelerate processing.
Translate model insights into actionable recommendations with clear visualizations for stakeholders.
Collaborate with cross‑functional teams to integrate analytics into business decision‑making.

What’s In It For You

We are committed to supporting your work‑life balance and overall well‑being, offering flexible scheduling options. Learn more about Lockheed Martin’s comprehensive benefits package here. Do you want to be part of a company culture that empowers employees to think big, lead with a growth mindset, and make the impossible a reality? We provide the resources and give you the flexibility to enable inspiration and focus – if you have the passion and courage to pursue challenging work, work hard, and have fun doing what you love then we want to build a better tomorrow with you.

Who You Are

A collaborative professional with deep expertise in applied statistics, machine learning, and high‑performance computing. You thrive on turning complex data into actionable business value, enjoy mentoring teammates, and seek continuous growth in cutting‑edge AI research.

What You Will Be Doing

As the Operations AI Engineer Senior - Level 3 you will be responsible for leading exploratory research and analysis that identifies novel patterns in complex data, applying statistical methods to validate hypotheses, and delivering business‑focused insights.

Conduct exploratory data analysis to uncover patterns and trends in large data sets.
Develop and validate predictive models using advanced statistical, deep‑learning, and optimization techniques.
Design and implement high‑performance computing solutions (GPU, distributed, cloud) to accelerate processing.
Translate model insights into actionable recommendations with clear visualizations for stakeholders.
Collaborate with cross‑functional teams to integrate analytics into business decision‑making.

What’s In It For You

We are committed to supporting your work‑life balance and overall well‑being, offering flexible scheduling options. Learn more about Lockheed Martin’s comprehensive benefits package here. Do you want to be part of a company culture that empowers employees to think big, lead with a growth mindset, and make the impossible a reality? We provide the resources and give you the flexibility to enable inspiration and focus – if you have the passion and courage to pursue challenging work, work hard, and have fun doing what you love then we want to build a better tomorrow with you.

Who You Are

A collaborative professional with deep expertise in applied statistics, machine learning, and high‑performance computing. You thrive on turning complex data into actionable business value, enjoy mentoring teammates, and seek continuous growth in cutting‑edge AI research.

Further Information About This Opportunity

MUST BE A U.S. CITIZEN - This position is located at a facility that requires special access.
The selected candidate must be able to obtain a secret clearance.
This position is in Fort Worth, TX. Discover Fort Worth

Perform exploratory research and analysis to identify novel and meaningful patterns in data and uses statistical methods to reject or accept proposed hypotheses about relationships or latent predictive factors discovered through their work to provide business value. Experience with and maintaining CI/CD pipelines

knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and container orchestration (Docker,Kubernetes).

Job Title

AI Engineer – Physical AI for Surgical Robotics (Cambridge, MA)

Job Description

AI Engineer – Physical AI for Surgical Robotics (Cambridge, MA)

Join Philips to help shape the next generation of intelligent surgical robotics. In this role, you will work with robotics, software, and clinical experts to develop first-of-a-kind Physical AI solutions that advance autonomy, decision-making, and workflow intelligence for image-guided procedures.

Your Role

Develop and apply Physical AI solutions for surgical robotics by combining model-based robotics methods with multimodal foundation models, including Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models.
Design and evaluate AI solutions that combine vision, language, and robot actions for image-guided interventions and surgical robotics applications.
Develop algorithms and software in an FDA-regulated environment.
Contribute to system architecture, algorithm design, experimentation, validation strategy, and technical documentation in alignment with medical device regulatory processes.
Partner closely with system engineering, design, clinical, regulatory, product management, and business marketing teams to translate research concepts into robust, production-oriented solutions.
Stay informed about the latest advancements in MedTech and AI, and actively contribute to intellectual property creation.

You're The Right Fit If

You’ve acquired 2+ years of experience applying AI or robotics methods to image-guided interventions, surgical robotics, medical imaging, or a closely related technology domain.
Your skills include:
You have experience with robotics foundation models, including Vision-Language-Action models, multimodal AI, large language models, or vision models. Familiarity with reinforcement learning and learning from demonstration is preferred.
You have a strong robotics background, including model-based methods for motion planning, control, or robotic autonomy.
You are a strong hands-on programmer who writes clean, maintainable code, follows modern software engineering practices, and works effectively within CI/CD processes. You are proficient in Python and modern AI/ML frameworks, with practical experience training, evaluating, and deploying machine learning models. Knowledge of C++ is preferred.
You can translate ambitious research goals into milestone-driven technical plans, prototypes, validation evidence, and clear documentation for externally funded programs. You are also comfortable translating the work into practical product development within a regulated medical device environment.
You have experience, or strong interest, in safety-bounded autonomy, uncertainty estimation, fail-safe control, or runtime monitoring for AI-enabled robotic systems.

You have a Master’s or PhD in Robotics, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical field. PhD is preferred.
You must be able to successfully perform the following minimum Physical, Cognitive and Environmental job requirements with or without accommodation for this position.
You can independently lead technical work from concept through implementation, define solution design, drive execution, and coordinate effectively across cross-functional teams and academic partners.

How We Work Together

We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week. Onsite roles require full-time presence in the company’s facilities. Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations.

This is an office role.

About Philips

We are a health technology company. We built our entire company around the belief that every human matters, and we won't stop until everybody everywhere has access to the quality healthcare that we all deserve. Do the work of your life to help improve the lives of others.

Learn more about our business.
Discover our rich and exciting history.
Learn more about our purpose.
Learn more about our culture.

Philips Transparency Details

The pay range for this position in Cambridge, MA is $129,000 to $205,000.

The actual base pay offered may vary within the posted ranges depending on multiple factors including job-related knowledge/skills, experience, business needs, geographical location, and internal equity.

In addition, other compensation, such as an annual incentive bonus, sales commission or long-term incentives may be offered. Employees are eligible to participate in our comprehensive Philips Total Rewards benefits program, which includes a generous PTO, 401k (up to 7% match), HSA (with company contribution), stock purchase plan, education reimbursement and much more. Details about our benefits can be found here.

At Philips, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top end of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent upon the facts and circumstances of each case.

Additional Information

US work authorization is a precondition of employment. The company will not consider candidates who require sponsorship for a work-authorized visa, now or in the future.

Company relocation benefits will not
be provided for this position. For this position, you must reside in or
within commuting distance to Cambridge, MA.

This requisition is expected to stay active for 45 days but may close earlier if a successful candidate is selected or business necessity dictates. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply as soon as possible to ensure consideration.

Proficiency in Python – write clean, well‑documented code and explain your logic.

Basic awareness of Generative AI capabilities such as large‑language models (LLMs)
Demonstrated initiative and research mindset – comfortable navigating documentation, exploring new tools, and proposing ideas.

Research‑oriented mindset – conducting industry/academic research, networking with peers, and surfacing innovative strategies.

Basic familiarity with Docker (or comparable container technology).

Research‑oriented mindset – conducting industry/academic research, networking with peers, and surfacing innovative strategies.

new_jobs.description:
At Capital One, we are creating responsible and reliable AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been an industry leader in using machine learning to create real-time, personalized customer experiences. Our investments in technology infrastructure and world-class talent — along with our deep experience in machine learning — position us to be at the forefront of enterprises leveraging AI. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI & ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. We are committed to continuing to build world-class applied science and engineering teams to deliver our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build.

Team Description:

The Intelligent Foundations and Experiences (IFX) team is at the center of bringing our vision for AI at Capital One to life. We work hand-in-hand with our partners across the company to advance the state of the art in science and AI engineering, and we build and deploy proprietary solutions that are central to our business and deliver value to millions of customers. Our AI models and platforms empower teams across Capital One to enhance their products with the transformative power of AI, in responsible and scalable ways for the highest leverage impact.

What You’ll Do:

Partner with a cross-functional team of engineers, research scientists, technical program managers, and product managers to deliver AI-powered products that change how our associates work and how our customers interact with Capital One.
Design, develop, test, deploy, and support AI software components including foundation model training, large language model inference, agents and multi-agent workflows, similarity search, guardrails, model evaluation, experimentation, governance, and observability, etc.
Leverage a broad stack of Open Source and SaaS AI technologies such as AWS Ultraclusters, Huggingface, VectorDBs, PyTorch, and more.
Invent and introduce state-of-the-art foundation model optimization techniques to improve the performance — scalability, cost, latency, throughput — of large scale production AI systems.
Contribute to the technical vision and the long term roadmap of foundational AI systems at Capital One.
Design, implement and optimize multi-model orchestration pipelines - integrating LLMs, vector search, and domain-specific models into unified systems
Establish and lead cost-performance governance reviews across AI systems, tracking GPU utilization, model throughput, and inference cost efficiency
Lead team design councils or design review boards to ensure technical consistency and compliance with AI engineering standards
Mentor Principal and Manager-level AI engineers, fostering cross-domain learning and elevating organizational technical maturity

The Ideal Candidate:

You love to build systems, take pride in the quality of your work, and also share our passion to do the right thing. You want to work on problems that will help change banking for good
Passion for staying abreast of the latest research, and an ability to intuitively understand scientific publications and judiciously apply novel techniques in production
You adapt quickly and thrive on bringing clarity to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and digging deep to uncover the root of problems and can articulate your findings concisely with clarity. You have the courage to share new ideas even when they are unproven
You are deeply Technical. You possess a strong foundation in engineering and mathematics, and your expertise in hardware, software, and AI enables you to see and exploit optimization opportunities that others miss
You are a resilient trailblazer who can forge new paths to achieve business goals when the route is unknown

Basic Qualifications:

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, AI, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields plus at least 6 years of experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies, or a Master's degree in Computer Science, AI, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields plus at least 4 years of experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies
At least 6 years of experience programming with Python, Go, Scala, CUDA, or Java

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience leading development AI systems with tradeoff decisions around cost, latency, throughput and accuracy
7+ years of experience deploying scalable and responsible AI solutions on cloud platforms (e.g. AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, or equivalent private cloud)
Experience designing, developing, delivering, and supporting complex AI systems
Experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies (e.g. LLM Inference, Similarity Search and VectorDBs, Guardrails, Memory) using Python, C++, C#, Java, CUDA, or Golang
Experience developing and applying state-of-the-art techniques for optimizing training and inference software to improve hardware utilization, latency, throughput, and cost
Experience in building agentic AI systems and agentic workflows
Passion for staying abreast of the latest AI research and AI systems, and judiciously apply novel techniques in production
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate complex AI concepts to peers
Experience architecting and integrating heterogeneous AI systems - including rule-based, retrieval-augmented, and generative components - into unified production pipelines
Experience defining and enforcing standards for ethical AI deployment, including explainability, fairness, and human-in-the-loop review processes
Demonstrated ability to balance model performance and operational cost through dynamic inference strategies and model compression
Experience right-sizing models, instance counts, and hardware types given requirements (e.g., context length, token inputs, token outputs)

About Us

Proofpoint is a global leader in human- and agent-centric cybersecurity. We protect how people, data, and AI agents connect across email, cloud, and collaboration tools. Over 80 of the Fortune 100, 10,000 large enterprises, and millions of smaller organizations trust Proofpoint to stop threats, prevent data loss, and build resilience across their people and AI workflows. Our mission is simple safeguard the digital world and empower people to work securely and confidently. Join us in our pursuit to defend data and protect people.

How We Work

At Proofpoint you’ll be part of a global team that breaks barriers to redefine cybersecurity guided by our BRAVE core values

Bold
in how we dream and innovate

Responsive
to feedback, challenges and opportunities

Accountable
for results and best in class outcomes

Visionary
in future focused problem-solving

Exceptional
in execution and impact

About The Role

We're looking for an AI Engineer II to design and ship internal AI-powered tools end-to-end. You'll own AI-powered applications, workflow automations, and integrations from concept through production, evaluating and integrating new AI capabilities as you go. This is a hands-on building role you'll write production code, not just prototype it, while partnering with business stakeholders and growing into fuller ownership at the next level.

Responsibilities

Design and build internal AI-powered tools and web applications end-to-end, including front-end, back-end, data, API, and LLM/AI integrations.
Own AI applications, workflow automations, and systems integrations from requirements gathering and technical design through production deployment and iteration.
Partner with Sales Operations, Revenue Analytics, and cross-functional stakeholders to translate business problems into scalable technical solutions that deliver measurable value.
Evaluate and integrate new AI models, APIs, frameworks, and development approaches based on business needs, technical feasibility, and performance.
Develop production-quality applications with appropriate testing, documentation, monitoring, and maintainability; troubleshoot and improve solutions post-launch based on user feedback and performance.
Build reusable AI capabilities, integrations, documentation, and development patterns that can be leveraged across teams and use cases.
Communicate technical concepts, solution designs, tradeoffs, and outcomes to technical and non-technical stakeholders, including presenting work to cross-functional audiences.

Qualifications

Required

1–2 years of hands-on experience building software, data products, or AI-powered tools through professional, internship, academic, or substantial independent project experience.
Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience in data analysis, application development, and statistical or machine-learning workflows.
Hands-on experience with machine learning and statistical modeling, including regression, classification, feature engineering, and model evaluation.
Experience working with large structured datasets using Snowflake, relational databases, or comparable cloud data platforms.
Experience developing or integrating REST APIs and backend services using FastAPI or similar frameworks, along with familiarity with modern web application development.
Demonstrated ability to ship functional tools or applications to real users and evaluate their performance using appropriate technical or quantitative measures.
Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills, including the ability to learn unfamiliar technologies, incorporate stakeholder feedback, and explain technical tradeoffs to non-technical audiences.

Preferred

Experience developing applications using LLMs, RAG, embeddings/vector search, prompt engineering, and LLM APIs such as OpenAI or Anthropic.
Familiarity with AI agents, tool/function calling, intent routing, retrieval systems, and workflow orchestration.
Experience with React and TypeScript or another modern front-end framework.
Experience with Docker, AWS, or comparable cloud and deployment technologies.
Familiarity with ETL/ELT pipelines, data modeling, JSON/metadata mappings, and multi-system data integrations.
Experience with Snowflake, Salesforce, or other GTM/revenue data systems.

Logistics

Full-time
Reports to Director, Revenue Analytics
Onsite/hybrid/remote per team policy

Why Proofpoint?

At Proofpoint, we believe that an exceptional career experience includes a comprehensive compensation and benefits package. Here are just a few reasons you’ll love working with us

Competitive compensation
Comprehensive benefits
Career success on your terms
Flexible work environment
Annual wellness and community outreach days
Always on recognition for your contributions
Global collaboration and networking opportunities

Our Culture

Our culture is rooted in values that inspire belonging, empower purpose and drive success-every day, for everyone.

We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. If you need accommodation during the application or interview process, please reach out to accessibility@proofpoint.com.

How To Apply

Interested? Submit your application along with any supporting information- we can’t wait to hear from you!

new_jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer, Generative ML, Level 4
new_jobs.description:
Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together.

The Company operates Snapchat, a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world, and Specs Inc., a wholly-owned subsidiary dedicated to making computing more human, in addition to Bitmoji, Saturn, and other digital services.

Snap’s Generative ML Platform team builds cutting-edge AI technologies that power creative, scalable experiences for hundreds of millions of Snapchatters worldwide. From multimodal LLMs and video generation to real-time AR, human understanding, and 3D content creation, we develop the full stack of generative AI, including foundational models, efficient infrastructure, and on-device and server-side inference. Our team creates intuitive tools, platforms, and agentic systems that empower creators, developers, and internal teams to bring ideas to life, while advancing personalized, human-centric experiences across mobile, web, and wearable devices like Spectacles.

We're looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to join our Generative ML team!

What you’ll do:

Develop innovative machine learning technology and products that serve millions of Snapchatters
Work on state of the art generative pipelines for image, video, language or audio generation
Deliver generative machine learning experiences on device
Build cutting-edge augmented reality experiences using generative and diffusion models
Partner with cross-functional Snap teams to explore and prototype new products

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

A proven passion for machine learning; you stay up-to-date with research and are excited about prototyping new ideas quickly
Strong software development skills in Python or C++
Proficiency working with major deep learning frameworks: PyTorch or TensorFlow
Knowledge of mathematics and deep learning foundations
Desire to solve open ambiguous problems
Desire to grow professionally, learn and help others
Ability to effectively collaborate with internal teams and external partners
Ability to work independently

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor’s Degree in a technical field such as computer science, mathematics, statistics or equivalent years of experience
3+ years of post-Bachelor’s machine learning experience; or Master’s degree in a technical field + 2+ year of post-grad machine learning experience; or PhD in a relevant technical field
Research or engineering experience in one or more of the following: generative models, efficient models, diffusion models, language models, or other related applications of machine learning

Preferred Qualifications:

Master's degree or PhD in a related technical field
Experience developing real-time software for mobile applications
Knowledge of GenAI, especially image, video, language and audio generation foundations
Knowledge of efficient model foundations
Track record of successful projects in GenAI field
Examples of your work such as open source projects, blog posts, Kaggle contests, top conference or journal publications, etc.

If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please provide us some information.

"Default Together" Policy at Snap: At Snap Inc. we believe that being together in person helps us build our culture faster, reinforce our values, and serve our community, customers and partners better through dynamic collaboration. Standard Job Description

AI Research Engineer Stf - Engineering Transformation

Strategic Product Development within Engineering Transformation is seeking a highly skilled Staff AI/ML Engineer
to join a cross-functional team advancing the Engineering Generative AI portfolio.

What You Will Be Doing

In this role, you will apply modern AI tools and techniques to solve complex Engineering challenges and develop scalable, governed AI capabilities.

This role offers the opportunity to work directly with Engineering organizations and their functional partners to scope opportunities, develop prototypes, and mature validated solutions for enterprise use. Ideally, you will have advanced experience in applied AI and ML, research, development and sustainment of Generative AI applications, and software engineering.

Key Responsibilities Will Include The Following

Working with Engineering users and cross-functional teams to identify high-value AI opportunities and translate workflows into technical requirements and deployable solutions.
Researching, developing, testing, deploying, and sustaining Generative AI, AI/ML, and agentic applications that improve Engineering ways of working.
Designing and implementing AI algorithms, applications, and services, including LLM-based retrieval, tool use, orchestration, and decision-support workflows.
Building and optimizing full-stack AI solutions, including user experiences, APIs, backend services, data connections, model integrations, and deployment pipelines.
Developing prototypes using approved AI-assisted development tools and mature successful capabilities into secure, tested, documented, enterprise-deployable solutions.
Applying Responsible AI Governance and Ethics (RAGE), cybersecurity, architecture, and DevSecOps requirements throughout development, testing, deployment, and sustainment.
Evaluating solution performance, reliability, safety, and user value through AI evaluation, automated testing, regression testing, monitoring, and user feedback.
Partnering with the AI Portfolio Chief Architect, Engineering Knowledge & Data Integration Architect, Data and AI Enablement, IT Applications, and Engineering Function teams to establish sustainable solutions and integrations.

Further Information About This Opportunity

This role is fully remote. US Citizenship is required due to system access.

Basic Qualifications

Hands-on experience developing and deploying AI/ML solutions at scale.
Experience with AI/ML programming languages, such as Python or C++, and software engineering practices for production applications.
Hands-on experience developing, fine-tuning, integrating, or deploying large language models and Generative AI applications.
Demonstrated expertise in prompt engineering, including designing, testing, and optimizing prompts for reliability, safety, and performance.
Experience deploying or hosting AI solutions and applications in production environments.
Bachelor's degree in a STEM discipline, such as Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related field.
US Citizenship is required due to system access

Desired Skills

Experience designing and implementing AI agents, planning or search approaches, tool-use APIs, multi-agent systems, or agentic workflows.
Experience with frameworks supporting AI agent orchestration, such as LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or LlamaIndex.
Experience implementing RAG, hybrid retrieval, semantic chunking, GraphRAG, knowledge graphs, or vector search.
Experience building Model Context Protocol (MCP) clients or servers to connect AI models, data, and tools.
Experience with AWS services and cloud-native infrastructure used to build and secure scalable AI applications.
Experience with AI evaluation, observability, guardrails, responsible AI, model-risk management, or RAGE-aligned practices.
Familiarity with Engineering tools and data, including PLM, requirements management, systems engineering, configuration management, software engineering, manufacturing, or quality.
